tei:div.tei:p: "$ (625)༄༅// dpal myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po'i byin rlabs rjes gnang gi bka' yig phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa tsintā ma ṇi'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

(626)༄༅// bla ma dang myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro ba kun la byams pa'i snying rje'i spyan// gdug pa can ngor sdang mig ltar gzigs ba// rgyal ba kun bskyed bla ma nag po ches// 'di dang gtan gyi bar chad kun sel mdzod// dpal ldan mgon po'i rgyud dang sgrub thabs tshul// ngo mtshar gsang ba zab mo nam mkha'i mdzod// mtsho skyes rdo rje bram ze yab sras sogs// grub mchog du ma'i rim pa las 'ongs phyir// mkhas chen rnams kyi thugs su'ang ma byon pa// dus gsum 'byon pa sgrol byed phreng ba las// shangs pa'i ring lugs rgyu skar bdag po gang*// sgo 'byed byin rlabs bka' rnams bshad par bya// snying rje drag po'i stobs su khyung pa'i gsang ba gsum gyis rtsod pa'i mtha' yi gdul bya ris su ma chad pa ma grol ba rnams btsan thabs su grol bar byed cing 'dod pa'i don yid bzhin tu stsol ba la ye shes dang*/ las dang 'jigs rten pa'i chos skyong ba gang gis kyang bskrun tu med cing sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mchog sgrub par byed ba myur mdzad ye shes mgon po'i chos skor mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor la rgya gar grub thob rnam gnyis kyis stsal ba'i gdams ngag nyid kyi thugs sras gtso bo rnam drug sogs la gnang ba dang*/ khyad par la stod pa dkon mchog mkhar nas brgyud pa'i stod lugs/ rmog lcogs pa rin chen brtson 'grus nas brgyud pa'i smad lugs gnyis shin tu grags che zhing grub mtha' kun gyis tshad mar 'dzin pa las// mgon po stod lugs la dbang bskur rjes gnang man ngag gi rnam (627) grangs zab la rgya che ba bzhugs bar snang yang deng sang be bum rtsa ba tsam gyi lung rgyun dang*/ rjes gnang 'ga' zhig byin rlabs chu bo gcig tu 'dres pa tsam las rgyun shin tu dkon cing*/ smad lugs mus chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor nas brgyud pa 'di nyid rje rin po che yab sras kyi phrin las dang lhan cig dzam gling kun tu khyab pas gangs can du byon pa'i chos skyong zhig la mchod sgrub kyi phrin las kyang mgon po 'di nyid rgya che bar snang*/

'di'i rjes gnang gi bka' srol sa kar sogs la rtsa ba mthing dkar gnyis tsam las mi bzhugs shing*/ de'ang grub mtha' rang lugs kyi lag len dang bstun pas rtsa ba'i gnad dang mthun min ci rigs 'dug /jo nang rje btsun chen po gong 'og la rnam par dag pa'i bka' srol 'ga' zhig 'dugs par 'dug kyang deng sang rin 'byung nang gi bka' lnga po las gzhan gyi rgyun mi bzhugs/ mkhas grub dge dpal bas bka' chen bcu gsum mtha' rten dang bcas par bsdus pa dang*/ gcig brgyud kyi bka' gsum/ be bum khyad par can gyi lung dang bcas pa dge phyogs su dar srol che zhing*/ mgon po 'di nyid brten pa la med du mi rung bar mthong nas/ lha mo gcig brgyud kyi bka' ma gtogs pa gzhan tshang ba kho bos kyang thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i zhal snga nas bka' drin tu thob pa yin no// de'i lugs la skyi shod sprul sku bstan 'dzin phrin las kyi yig cha mchis na'ang*/ 'dir rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' srol rgyun bzhugs pa rnams de nyid gtso bo byas/ mi (628) bzhugs pa rnams kha bskangs te bshad par bya'o// de'ang spyi shod pa'i yig char/ 1rtsa ba'i rjes gnang bar chad kun sel/ 2de la dmigs pa'i khyad par bsgyur ba gtor dbang bar chad kun sel/ 3grib sel mgon po/ 4bla mgon dbyer med/ 5gnad dbang dang mkha' 'gro dbang sdud lhan cig pa/ 6mgon po mchin kha/ 7sa ra ha'i lugs kyi zhal gsum phyag drug 8/mgon po rgyan can gsang sgrub yum can/ 9lha bzhi dril sgrub/ 10dbang gi rgyal po/ 11tshe bdag mgon po/ 12mgon po snying zhugs/ 13yid bzhin nor bu rnams dang*/ spyi'i mtha' rten brtul zhugs kyi rjes su gnang ba bcas kyi go rim du bzhugs na'ang*/ der mgon ser blo 'phel gyi bka' ma tshang ba dkyus su bcug /mgon po snying zhugs gcig brgyud yin pas zur du phyes pa'i bcu gsum dang*/

go rim yang sgrub thabs rin 'byung rtsa bar byas/ der ma bzhugs pa rnams kha bskangs te bshad par bya'o// de la kun gyi rtsa bar gyur pa bka' chen dang po rjes gnang bar chad kun sel rje btsun rin po che'i gsung rab las byung ba la kha 'phang nag 'gros su bsdebs pa ni/ /oṃ swa sti/ spyan ras gzigs dbang sgrol ma dang*// rdo rje phag mos legs brgyan pa// byin rlabs mgon po cher btud nas// ting 'dzin dbang bskur cho ga bshad/ /bar chad kun sel gyi bka' byed par 'dod pas gnas dben par nyer dgu la sogs pa'i dus bzang por maṇḍal zlum po'i dbus su chos 'byung gru gsum mthing kha me ri can rtse mo tshur bstan pa/ dbus su nyi gdan drug la tshom bu sku mdog dang mthun par 'god/ phyi rol gru bcad dmar po/ zlum skor gyi phyi la'ang rdo rwa me ri bya/ der mañdzi'i steng du/ thod pa'i snod gang yang rung ba'i nang du/ bdud rtsi lngas spags pa'i gtor ma nor gzugs mche ba re 'god cing*/ 'khor gyi gtor ma bzhengs na/ snod de nyid du gnod sbyin la rtse mo g.yas su dkyus pa gru gsum/ las mgon la gru gsum phra mo/ gzhan gsum la zlum po phra mo re bya/ gtor ma chen po la mda' dar dang*/ tsakra yi btsugs/ 'bul gtor rgyas pa bshams na gtor sgrub yin la/ bsdu na zlum gtor che ba zhig mdun du bsham/ nang mchod dang*/ mchod pa gzhan rnams ci bde bar bsgrigs/ de nas slob dpon gyi bya ba ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma bshams la/ sumbha sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥ(629)hrīḥ zhes byin gyis brlab/ phaiṃ badzra ā ra lli hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badzra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya st+waṃ/ dṛ shya hoḥ sa mgron rnams bkug /oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yakṣa rakṣa sa bhū ta pre ta pi shā tsi un mā da a pa sma ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+yad yaḥ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛhṇantu sa ma ya rakṣantu ma ma sarba siddhimme pra ya tstshantu ya thai baṃ ya thaiṣṭaṃ bhuñdza tha dzi ghra tha pi pa tha mā ti kra ma tha/

ma ma sarba kā ra ta ya sat+su khaṃ bi shuddha ye/ sa hā yi kā bhawantu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum gyis phul/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ pra tī tstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā dyaṃ/ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ nas/ shabda 'i bar gyis mchod/ /lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas// klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas// 'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po dang*// gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// 'byung po'i tshogs= /sha za'i tshogs= /smyo byed tshogs= /rjed byed tshogs= /ma mo'i tshogs rnams= /de la sogs te 'byung po'i tshogs// ma lus ji snyed yod pa rnams// 'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /dam can khyed rnams dkyil 'khor gyi// las la srung ba dam pa dang*// yul phyogs 'di dang sbyin bdag dang*// slob ma la yang shis par mdzod// gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba'i// 'byung po'i tshogs rnams gang yin pa// gtor ma'i lhag ma 'di longs la// da lta nyid du gzhan du dengs// ci ste 'gro bar mi byed na// rdo rje 'dzin chen khros ba'i bkas// mtshon cha 'bar ba'i sprin spros nas// lus sems rdul du brlag ta re// zhes gtor ma phyir dor la drag sngags rol mo bcas mtshams bcad/ gnas yo byin rlabs ni gong ltar bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi nang du chud pa'i bhrūṃ las gnas khang gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ rnams las byung zhing lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ (630)mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad bzang zhing gya nom pa/ yul dus chad pa med par yongs su khyab cing*/ rnam 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa rang bzhin bde stong gi ye shes/

rnam pa mchod rdzas kyi sprin phung byed las rang gzhan mtha' dag zag med kyi bde bas tshims par byed pas phyi nang thams cad du gang bar gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā dyaṃ= oṃ badzra pu ṣpe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai wi dya/ shabda āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā brta ya ā brta ya hoḥ oṃ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ/ rol mos byin 'bebs shing*/ oṃ badzra ghāṇaḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba buddha kṣe tra pra tsā li te/ pra dzñā pā ra mi tā nā da sambha wa te badzra dharma hṛ da ya santo ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥhoḥhoḥ.āḥkhaṃ swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ de nas bdag bskyed ni/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub bam rgyud sde gang yang rung ba la bya chog kyang*/ rgyud sde lnga gtso bsdus kyi lus dkyil tsam la brten pa ches legs pas de'i yig cha zur gsal ltar/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs/ skyabs sems srung 'khor nas brtsams/ bzlas pa/ bsdu ldangs kyi bar du grub pa dang*/ mdun bskyed a mṛ ta dang*/ swā bhā wa sa bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/ mdun tu hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi nang mi bzad pa'i dur khrod chen po'i dbus su/ paṃ las padma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du/ gaṃ dkar po 'od du zhu ba las/ dpal tshogs kyi bdag po sku mdog dkar po glang po che'i dbu la spyan gsum pa phyag g.yas sa'i snying po la phug lo ma dang bcas pa zhal du gsol ba/ g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa nyal stabs su gnas pa/ de'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag las gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po (631)phyag drug pa/ skye 'gro'i re ba tshul bzhin du skong ba/

sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin ltar rab tu gnag pa/ zhal gcig phyag drug pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'dril ba/ rab tu bzhad pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dang*/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ dpral bar sindhu ra'i thig les byugs pa/ spyi bor mi bskyod rgyal pos rgyas btab pa phyag g.yas dang pos rdo rje gri gug dang*/ g.yon dang pos thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ g.yas par pas thod skam gyi phreng ba/ tha mas ḍā ma ru drag tu 'khrol ba/ g.yon gnyis pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ tha ma na rdo rje zhags pa bsnams pa/ zhabs gnyis srid gsum rnam par gnon pa'i shugs can mnyam pa'i stabs krig krig zhabs kyis bgegs kyi rgyal po mnan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs la/ dar ljang gu'i ske rags bcings pa/ sbrul sngon pos dbu skra bcings shing*/ dmar po'i snyan cha/ khra bo'i dpung rgyan/ dkar po'i mgul rgyan/ ser po'i lag gdub/ ljang gu'i do shal/ dkar po'i rkang gdub dang ska rags can/ phyag zhabs thams cad dril bu g.yer kha'i phreng ba dang ldan pa/ sbom thung yan lag hrag pa/ gzi brjid mtha' yas pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan rin po che'i rtse phran can dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis mdzes pa/ 'jigs pa'i nga ro 'brug ltar sgrogs pas/ bdud dang bgegs thams cad brlag par mdzad pa/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing*/ tsandan gyi sdong po la rgyab brten pa'o// de'i g.yon du khrag zhags 'khrugs pa'i rgya mtsho'i dbus su/ bhyoḥlas dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ sku mdog nag mo phyag g.yas bdud kyi khram shing nag po (632)phyar shing*/ g.yon nad kyi rkyal pa 'dzin pa/ me rlung 'tshubs ma'i dbus na bzhugs shing*/

dre'u rta rkang gsum la chibs pa/ 'khor sha za dang ma mo mkha' 'gro 'bum sdes bskor ba'o// gtso bo'i mdun du hūm̐ las gnod sbyin kṣe tra pā la/ sku mdog mthing nag kha gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs nas dgra la 'o dod 'bod pa/ shangs nas dus mtha'i rlung ldang ba/ phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la phyar bas lha dang lha ma yin thams cad skrag par byed pa// g.yon thod khrag dgra bgegs kyi snying dang bcas pa gtso bo'i zhal du stob pa/ dom nag smyon pa la chibs pa/ g.yas su bhyo las dbang phyug dzi na mi tra sku mdog dmar nag /g.yas ḍā ma ru 'khrol zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ rgyab tu dzaḥlas gshin rje ṭa kki rā dza sku mdog dmar nag /phyag g.yas zhags pa dgra la 'phen cing*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub gnod byed la sdigs pa/ g.yon du las bdud mgon chen po trakshad sku mdog nag po phyag g.yas su mtshon mdung dmar rtse gsum pa dgra bo'i snying gar bsnun pa/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba bsnams pa/ ya sos ma mchu mnan pa/ dar nag gi 'jol ber dang*/ sag ti'i lham yu ring gsol ba/ gser gyi ske rags bcings pa/ bdud rta nag po rting dkar la chibs pa/ bzhi ka'ang khro bo las mkhan gyi cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa'o// de'i phyi rol du shar du brgya byin/ shar lhor me lha/ lhor gshin rje/ lho nub tu srin po/ nub tu chu lha/ nub byang du rlung lha/ byang du gnod sbyin/ byang shar du 'byung po/ steng du tshangs pa/ 'og tu sa bdag ste phyogs skyong bcu/ gzhan yang lha chen po brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/ gza' chen po brgyad/ 'jigs byed chen po dgu/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ rgyal po chen po bzhi ste/ gtsang rigs kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga po (633)thams cad kyang 'khor bye ba bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs sha la dga' ba/ khrag la rol ba/ snying rje med pa/

kha gdangs pa/ mig rtsa dmar ba/ lag na gdug pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs pa thogs pa skad cig la skye 'gro thams cad kyi srog dbugs sdud pa/ gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po dang*/ gshin rje dang*/ bdud dang ma mo'i cha lugs can/ sa gzhi bar snang nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad yongs su gang ba/ thams cad kyang sgrub pa po'i re 'dod tshul bzhin du skong bar mdzad pa'o// de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ shar lho dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal/ tsandan gyi shing rkang gcig pa'i drung nas/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa/ steng na rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ g.yas na dpa' bo ngar dang bcas shing*/ g.yon na dpa' mo 'dzum dang bcas pa/ bka' sdod zhing skyong pho nya/ dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad skad cig nyid la ḍā ma ru dang dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra si li li/ khro lo lo/ 'ur 'ur chem chem byon par gyur// hūm̐/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur gshegs ma hā kā la che// dpal ldan mgon po 'khor dang bcas// dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// kṣe tra pā la la sogs pa// 'khor gyi bka' nyan gnod sbyin tshogs// bstan pa bsrung par zhal bzhes pa'i// dam can rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol// dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir gshegs nas kyang*// rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rtags dang mtshan ma ston pa dang*// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// oṃ badzra ma hā kā la sa pa ri wa ra

ces pa'i rjes su*/ kṣiṃ ring po nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod/ /de nas kṣiṃ gi gnas su e hye hi bcug pa dang*/ badzra sa mā (634)dzaḥ bcug pa rnams lan gsum gsum brjod pas/ myur mdzad 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim// hūm̐/ bdud 'dul dmag dpon nag po che// rab brjid 'khor gyi tshogs dang bcas// dgra bgegs ma lus 'dul ba'i phyir// nag po chen po bzhugs su gsol// padma ka ma la staṃ/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tī tstsha swā hā/ de bzhin duu pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai bi dya/ shabda zhes sbyar ro/ /snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btag la nang mchod 'bul/ chos dbyings ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// gdug pa 'dul phyir khros pa'i sku// bstan pa'i ru dra 'joms mdzad pa'i// nag po che la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de nas gsol 'debs ni/ na mo buddhā ya/ na mo gu ru he/ badzra bī ra bī re ṇi/ shrī ḍā ka ḍā ki nī/ dzo ga dzo gi nī/ sarba buddha bo dhi sa twa ya sha ra ṇaṃ gatstsha mi/ kye kye phyogs bcu dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /dpa' bo dang dpa' mor bcas pa rnams kyis= sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis= dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i lha tshogs/ ye shes la sgrib pa mi mnga' ba/ thugs rje la phyi bshol mi mnga' ba// mthu dang nus pa la thogs pa mi mnga' ba/ byin rlabs la rgyang ring thung mi mnga' ba/ khyed rnams kyi sku'i sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig /gsung gi sgo nas= thugs kyi sgo nas= sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mi zad pa'i sgo nas= da lta nyid du= myur pa nyid du= 'dug sa 'di nyid du byin gyis brlab tu gsol// bla ma mgon po dbyer med la// bdag ni dad pas gsol 'debs kyi// bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi// nyon mongs ma lus bsal ba dang*// dngos grub ma lus stsal du (635)gsol/

/de nas bshags pa bya ba ni// rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas pa'i mthar/ rdo rje 'chang dang dpal ldan shā bā ri// rgyal ba mi tra grub chen rā hu la// a mi de ba lo ke shwa ra dang*// ha ya grī ba padma 'byung gnas dpal// khyung po dzo ki ratna birya dang*// dharma singha dharma pra dzñā dang*// birya sidha mkhas grub chos rje sogs// rin chen brgyud pa'i bla ma dgongs su gsol// 'gro ba'i re skong yon tan rab rdzogs pa'i// brgyud ldan bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas la// dag pa gnyis ldan chos skur ma rtogs par// 'jig rten rtog bcas dbang gyur mthol lo bshags// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las dang*// phyi nang gsang ba'i lha rnams dgongs su gsol// bdag cag theg mchog sngags kyi sgor zhugs nas// rtsa ba yan lag 'gal nyams mthol lo bshags// mthu stobs nus pa phrin las phun tshogs shing*// skad cig dran pas bar chad thams cad sol// 'du 'bral med par dngos grub ster mdzad pa'i// ye shes mgon po phyag drug dgongs su gsol// dur khrod nags 'dabs chu gling bas mtha' ru// phyi nang rten dang dam rdzas tshogs gyur nas// bsnyen sgrub bskang bshags tshul bzhin ma grub par// le lo g.yeng ba'i dbang gyur mthol lo bshags// khyad par gsang ba'i rten mchog bla na med// bla ma mgon po dbyer med bde chen sku// khyod la yid ches mos gus 'bral med kyis// rnam dag chos skur ma rtogs mthol lo bshags// bdag ni ma rig 'khrul pa'i dbang gyur te// bla ma mgon po 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi// sku gsung thugs dang 'gal ba ci mchis pa// gnong zhing 'gyod pa'i sems dang bcas nas kyang*// lha mchog khyod kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags// ye shes bka' sgrub las kyi pho nya mdzad// kṣe tra pā la dzi na mi tra dang*// ṭā kki rā dza trakshad re ma tī// phyogs skyong bcu dang gtsang rigs dgongs (636)su gsol// ji ltar khyed kyis khas blangs dam bcas bzhin// bdag gi phrin las yengs med sgrub pa la// yi chad bgyis shing sha khrag gtor tshogs kyis// gtong rag dus su ma thongs mthol lo bshags// mngon shes med pas nyes skyon ma rtogs par// bstan pa 'jig dang bla ma'i sku dgra la// drag po'i las kyis tshar gcod ma bgyis par// gsang ba bsgrags shing byams bgyis mthol lo bshags// dam nyams gtam 'dres grib phog zas zos dang*// rgyu chung phud nyams 'gal 'khrul nor la sogs// nyes skyon 'khrul pa'i tshogs rnams ci mchis pa// gnong zhing 'gyod pa'i sgo nas mthol lo bshags// sku yi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags// gsung gi=

/thugs kyi /rtsa ba'i= /yan lag= /tshor te= /ma tshor= /nyams grib dag phyir bshags pa 'di byas pas// dpal ldan mgon po 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis// pha ma bu tsha bzhin du bzod bzhes la// dngos grub thams cad bdag la dus 'dir stsol// bshags dang bshags par bya ba mi dmigs kyang*// rnam par rtog pa'i bag chags dag bya'i phyir// rje btsun dam pa yul gyi mchog rnams la// rab tu bshags pas bde chen thob gyur cig /gsol 'debs dang bshags pa'ang mi spyon bor bas kyang rung ngo*// de nas bzlas pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sngags kyi phreng ba rnams kha dog nag po 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba phreng rdog ltar gnas pa la 'od zer sna lnga phrer thag gi tshul du brgyus pa rang gi zhal nas thon mgon po'i zhal du zhugs/ mgon po'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ yang hūm̐ las byung*/ mgon po'i lte ba nas thon/ bdag gi lte bar zhugs/ snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim/ de ltar rtag tu 'khor lo ltar 'khor ba ra bsams la/ oṃ badzra ma hā kā la kṣiṃ kṣe tra bighnān bi na ya ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ ces snying po ci 'grub bzlas/ drag po'i bzlas pa dmigs pa gsal btab ste/ oṃ shri ma hā ka (637)la shā sa na/ u pa ha ri ṇi/ e ṣo pañtsi ma/ kā lo3yaṃ i daṃ ratna tra yā ya/ a pa ka rī ṇaṃ/ ya ti pra ti dzñā/ sma ra si tā dā/ i daṃ duṣṭaṃ/ khā hi khā hi/ mā ra mā ra/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa/ bandha bandha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ dī na me ke na mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pa ni drag sngags te 'bod rbad bsad gsum yang 'di la tshang bar bshad do/ /oṃ shrī de wi hūm̐ phaṭa/ lha mo'i mtshan sngags so// oṃ kṣe tra pā la bighnan hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dzi na mi tra pa shaṃ ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ṭa kki rā dza sa ma ya bhyoḥdu dza hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ du yo ga dza ma hā kā la trakshad hūm̐ phaṭa/ las mkhan bzhi'i snying po'o// de ltar bzlas pa ci 'grub byas nas/

mthar mchod gtor/ badzra a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ swa bhā lba sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kam̐ las mi mgo'i skyed bu gsum/ de'i steng du a las thod pa mtshan ldan yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bhrūṃ āṃ dzriṃ khaṃ hūm̐ rnams las sha lnga/ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ bam̐ rnams las bdud rtsi lnga/ steng gi nam mkha' la oṃ dkar po a las zla ba/ hūm̐ las rdo rje rnams brtsegs pa/ rlung g.yos me sbar/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga 'od du zhu/ yi ge 'bru gsum las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ de rnams kyi 'od kyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdo rje gsum ye shes kyi bdud rtsir spyan drangs te thim/ oṃ dang zla ba rdo rje rnams kyang 'od du zhu zhing thim pas/ kha dog dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa zad mi shes pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas byin brlabs/ mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje dmar po'i 'od kyi sbu gus gtor ma drangs te gsol bas thugs rgyud zag med kyi bde bas tshims nas dgyes par gyur/ snying po'i mthar/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ badzra ma hā kā la kṣiṃ kṣe tra bighnān bi nā ya ka traka rakmo ba liṃ ta maṃ sa rakta ru ti ra kha kha khā hi khā hi/ de bzhin du 'khor rnams la snying po'i mthar/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes btags la/ lan gsum gsum gyis phul/ oṃ ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod// nang mchod sngar bzhin phul la/ dpal ye (638)shes kyi mgon po legs ldan nag po/ bdud gcod kyi skyes bu/ srog gcod kyi shan pa/ bdud 'dul gyi dmag dpon/ srin po laṅka pu ri'i grong khyer sum brtsegs brlag par mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor pa'i dgra lha/ rig 'dzin gyi srung ma/ dam nyams kyi srog bdud chen po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dam rdzas rgyan dang ldan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/

sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi chos 'khor skyongs// bla ma'i sku tshe srings/ khyad par du dkon mchog gsum la gnod par byed pa dang*/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la bsam sbyor ngan par byed pa thams cad zhi bar mdzod cig /gal te zhi bas 'dul du ma 'tshal na bsad pa dang*/ bskrad pa dang*/ dbye ba dang*/ rengs pa dang*/ gzir ba dang*/ sdigs shing dpa' skong ba la sogs pa drag po'i phrin las kyis tshar bcad du gsol// bla ma mgon po 'khor bcas la// bdag gis mchod gtor phul ba yis// dkon mchog dbu 'phang smad pa dang*// theg pa chen po sun 'byin dang*// bstan pa 'jig dang dbyen byed dang*// bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba dang*// rnal 'byor bdag la sdang ba rnams// de kun nag po chen pos sgrol// mā ra ya phaṭa/ sa ma ya/ bstod pa ni/ /hūm̐/ myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhabs gdub dang bcas bi nā ya ka mnan// nag po chen po stag gi sham thabs can// phyag drug sbrul gyi rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan// g.yas pas gri gug bar pas phreng ba 'dzin// tha mas ḍā ma ru ni drag tu 'khrol// g.yon pas thod pa dang ni mdung rtse gsum// de bzhin zhags pa bzung nas 'ching bar byed// drag po'i zhal gdangs mche ba rnam par gtsigs// spyan gsum drag po'i dbu skra gyen du 'bar// dpral bar sindhu ra yi thig les byugs// spyi bor mi bskyod rgyal pos rgyas btab brtan// khrag 'dzag mi mgo lnga bcu'i (639)do shal can// rin chen thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan// shing las byon nas gtor ma len mdzad pa'i// dpal ldan phyag drug pa la phyag 'tshal bstod// bhyoḥ khrag mtsho chil chil khol ba'i klong dkyil na// tsho chen dre'u'i steng na gzi brjid 'bar// mthing nag sku la zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// bdud kyi khram shing nad kyi rkyal pa bsnams// sku yi sprul pas sangs rgyas bstan pa srung*// gsung gi sprul pas khams gsum g.yo bar byed// thugs ni mi 'gyur 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma// ma gcig re ma tī la phyag 'tshal lo// hūm̐/

dpal ldan mgon po'i phyogs bzhi'i bka' nyan pa// ye shes bka' sgrub las kyi pho nya mdzad// ma rungs kun 'dul sprul pa sna tshogs 'gyed// las byed pho nya bzhi la bdag cag bstod// dbang po gshin rje chu lha gnod sbyin dang*// me lha srin po rlung lha 'byung po dang*// steng gi tshangs pa sa yi lha mo ste// sprul pa'i phyogs skyong bcu la phyag 'tshal bstod// dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga dang*// dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs rnams// sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi// mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad sol// mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol ba dang*// bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /de nas 'og nas 'byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur nyid dmigs pas bdag 'jug tu blangs/ slob ma'i rgyud byin gyis brlab pa'i don du 'dir yang bzlas pa cung zad bya/ slob ma rnams khrus bya/ gral la 'khod pa la me tog bkye bsdu byas te/ slob dpon gyis/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dpal he ru ka'i go 'phang la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du gnas skabs su phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad gdon bgegs thams cad tshar gcod cing*/ rnam bzhi'i phrin las ci 'dod lhun gyis grub pa dang*/ mthar thug myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang mngon du bya ba'i slad du dpal (640)ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i bka' gtad byin rlabs kyi rim pa gsan snyam pas ma yengs par lhag pa'i thugs bskyed gsal btab ste gsan par zhu/ de yang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug chen po 'di nyid/ nges pa'i don du rgyal ba thams cad kyi 'char gzhi ste rgyal ba kun gyi yab tu gyur kyang*/ thun mong gi snang ngor rgyal ba'i sras kyi tshul bstan skabs// bskal ba mang por tshogs bsags sa bcu pa khyad par can brnyes/ 'od zer chen po'i dbang bskur thob/ rgyal sras thu bo'i gral du bzhugs skabs shig thugs bskyed kyi dam bca' 'di lta bu mdzad de/

phyogs bcu rab 'byams mu med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir/ bdag gis sems can gyi don bya/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba las bdag gis sgrol dgos pa las/ 'khor ba'i gnas 'dir sems can gcig kyang ma lus pa sangs rgyas kyi sa la ma 'khod bar du bdag sangs rgyas thob par mi bya/ sems can gcig kyang ma lus pa sangs rgyas kyi sa la bkod zin pa na/ de'i rjes su bdag nyid sangs rgyas thob na legs kyi/ gzhan du na bdag 'khor ba nyid du gnas te sems can gyi don bya'o// gal te bdag dam bca' 'di las 'das na lus tshal pa stong du 'gas par gyur cig ces dbu bsnyung mdzad/ de nas brtsams te ri bo po ta lar bzhugs nas sprul pa mtha' yas pas skad cig re rer sems can dpag tu med pa smin grol du mdzad na gzhan tshad bzung bar ga la nus/ de lta bu bskal pa ji snyed gcig song nas/ dus lan gcig /da ni sems can mang po thar grol byung yod dgongs/ mngon shes kyis gzigs pas/ sems can gyi khams la 'phel 'grib med/ nyung du ma song ba'i khar sems can rnams snyigs ma lnga bdo bas gdul dka' bar gzigs nas da ni bdag gis sems can gyi don bya bar mi nus dgongs sngar gyi thugs bskyed (641)dam bca' btang ba'i tshul mdzad pa na sku lus tshal pa stong du gas skad/ der 'phags pa nyid kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni 'od dpag med pa yin pas mngon sum du byon te/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis de lta bu'i sems bskyed btang ba de ma legs/ da dam bca' slar gso ba sogs kyi don du sngar gyi de bas rgya che ba'i sems bskyed gyis shig gsungs/ sku lus tshal ba stong dbu bcu gcig ngang phyag stong du byin gyis brlabs so// de nas dgongs pa slar yang rgya bskyed de snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i sems can ma rungs pa rnams drag pos 'dul ba dang*/ chos byed rnams kyang bar do'i 'jigs pa las mi thar bar gzigs nas bar do las skyob pa dang*/

snyigs dus skye bo rnams dbul phongs kho na sdug bsngal che bas de'i gnyen por bsam pa tsam gyis dgos 'dod 'byung ba ste/ phrin las rnam pa gsum gyi sgo nas thugs bskyed snga ma las lhag pa'i tshul du dgongs/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs ka nas hūm̐ gcig byung ste/ de nyid myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon por gyur pa na/ zhing khams thams cad du sa rnam pa drug tu g.yos/ bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag tu med pa la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu bsngags pa brjod/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi sprul pa'i khro bo chen por dbang bskur zhing mnga' gsol lo// de nas brtsams te sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams thams cad du bstan pa bsrung zhing bzhugs pa lags/ ye shes kyi mgon po chen po 'di nyid kyi sgrub skor 'phags bod kyi phyogs 'dir dar ba'i tshul dang*/ grub pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis rtags mngon gyur du bstan pa'i ngo mtshar rnam thar brjod las 'das shing*/ de dag gi lo rgyus rgyas pa rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung rabs sogs su gsal ba (642)la/ mdor bsdu na/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa mya ngan las 'das nas lo drug brgyar nye ba na/ grub thob chen po sha ba ri pa byon te grub pa brnyes/ mgon po 'di nyid zhal gzigs te srog sngags sgrub skor dang bcas pa gnang*/ phrin las thogs med du sgrub/ dpal sha ba ris/ rje btsun mai tri pa la gnang*/ rje mai tri pa ni/ bi kra ma shī lar bzhugs dus bskyed pa'i rim pa la brtan pa thob kyang gnas lugs kyi de nyid ma rtogs nas/ lhag pa'i lha la gsol ba btab pas/ lho phyogs dpal gyi rir song zhig /ri khrod mgon pos rjes su 'dzin par 'gyur zhes lung bstan pa ltar byon/ grub thob sha ba ris kyang phyag rgya chen po'i gdams pa mtha' dag stsal zhing dbang sgrub skor rnams gnang*/

gnas lugs kyi gzigs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam/ chos skyong bran bzhin khol bar gyur to// mai tri pa chen pos/ mkhas grub chen po khyung po lo tsā ba la gnang ste/ khyung po lo tsā ba de ni rus khyung po/ 'khrungs yul snye mor ram/ dang por bon dang*/ de nas chos rdzogs pa chen po gsan te nyan bshad sgom sgrub mdzad/ de nas kor ni ru pa bsten dgyes rdor dang phyag chen gyi skor mtha' dag gsan/ dgung lo lnga bcu nga gnyis bzhes pa la bal po dang rgya gar du phebs snga phyir rgya bal bod gsum du 'byon bzhugs mdzad/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i bla ma brgya dang lnga bcu tsam bsten te/ gtso bo rdo rje gdan pa bsod nams 'byung gnas/ mai tri pa/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ rā hu la/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma chen mo ni gu ma/ su kha siddhi ste drug po de rnams rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog tu mdzad de/ bla ma dam pa de rnams kyi thugs bcud longs shing*/ mdo rgyud gzhung lugs man ngag thams cad la mkhas grub 'gran zla dang bral bar gyur/ bod du byon khar rje mai tri pa la bdag cag bod longs spyod chung bas nor sgrub myur la byin (643)rlabs che ba zhig zhu zhus pas/ mgon po 'di'i lo rgyus gsungs shing*/ gdams pa khyad par can yid bzhin kyi nor bu lta bu yin gsungs te dbang man ngag rnams gnang zhing lung bstan pa yang mdzad do// grub thob chen po khyung po 'di ni sku lus kyi bkod pa brgya rtsa brgyad cig car ston pa dang*/ brag ri la thogs pa med par bzhud pa dang*/ yi dam dang mgon po rtag tu zhal gzigs/ sprul pa'i dmag bkye nus pa sogs rnam thar ngo mtshar dpag par dka' ba ste ches che ba'i grub thob yongs su grags pa dang*/ khyad par mgon po 'di nyid zhag bcu gsum sgrub pa'i tshul mdzad pas zhal mngon sum du bstan cing*/ de phyin chad bran bzhin du 'khol ba dang*/ rdo rje gdan pa'i drung du gser srang brgyad cu'i tshogs 'khor chen pos grub thob rnams nyin zhag mang du mchod de bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi skal bzhus pa'i skabs su'ang*/

thams cad gcig bsdus mgon po 'di nyid kho na ched du bsngags shing*/ rigs kyi bu khyod dang khyod kyi slob ma brgyud 'dzin dang bcas pa la dbang bskur byin gyis brlab cing phrin las rnam pa lnga bsgrub par bya'o zhes mi 'gyur rdo rje'i tshig gis zhal 'ches pas/ dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud pa gtso bor gyur pa'i ye shes mkha' 'gro ni gu'i gdams pa nyams su len pa rnams la chos skyong 'dis ma bsgrubs par yang phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med du bsgrub pa/ sgrub pa po la zhal ston pa sogs ches cher 'go ba yin no// de lta bu'i ye shes mgon po'i chos skor phran tshegs ci rigs mkhas grub khyung pos slob ma gzhan dang gzhan la gnang ba yod mod kyang*/ la stod pa dkon mchog mkhar/ rtogs ldan zhang sgom chos seng*/ rmog lcogs pa rin chen brtson 'grus gsum la rdzogs par gnang bas snga ma las brgyud pa la mgon po lha dgu/ phyag stong (644)spyan stong rgyan can gyi skor mang po la sogs pa byin rlabs kyi sgo chen po dang ldan pa mtha' yas par bzhugs pa la ni mgon po stod lugs su grags la/ phyi ma gnyis kyi gdams ngag mtha' dag dbon ston skyer sgang ba chen po la 'dus/ des sangs rgyas gnyan ston/ des 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa la gnang*/ de nas gcig brgyud kyi bka' rgya grol bas/ mkhas grub gtsang ma shangs ston dang bsam ldings pa gzhon nu grub/ ri gong gdan sa pa/ slob dpon a'i seng ge la sogs pa skal ldan rnams la 'chad 'gyur gyi bka' la sogs pa rgya cher stsal ba la mgon po smad lugs su grags pa ste/ de ltar bka' srol gtso bor gnyis las 'dir smad lugs yin/ de la'ang gdan sa pa nas phag mo gru pa dang tshogs sde bzhi sogs la brgyud de dbus su dar rgyas chen po byung ba dang*/ bsam sdings lugs la lho gcod gnyis/ shangs ston slob ma 'jag pa la stod smad bar brgyud gsum sogs byung*/

de dag las mched de mgon po dkar mthing gi skor rnams sa kar gnyis kyis mtshon pa'i chos sde du mar 'phel/ rje btsun tsong kha pa yab sras kyis 'jag pa'i slob brgyud rnams las gsan te mgon po 'di'i phrin las bod dang bod chen po/ rgya sog gi rgyal khams tshun chad du da lta'i bar du rgya che la rgyun chags pa dang*/ khyad par rin chen rnam bdun phyi ma nas jo nang rje btsun rin po cher bka' babs shing rje btsun nyid kyis thun mong ma yin pa'i chos skyong gi gtso bor mdzad/ de lta'i bar du byin rlabs kyi gzi byin ma nyams par bzhugs pa yin la/ de ltar mkhas grub byung po nas bzung brgyud pa'i bla ma rim par byon pa thams cad kyang shes bya kun la mkhyen pa rgyas shing mkhas btsun bzang po'i phul du gyur/ 'jig rten chos brgyad la ni thugs log /'khor 'das thams cad ni sgyu ma lta bur gzigs/ gnas lugs kyi rtogs pa nam mkha' (645)dang mnyam/ byams snying rje phyogs med du khyab/ yi dam dpag tu med pa zhal gzigs/ chos skyong srung ma bran bzhin 'khol/ gzhan phan 'gro don rang shar lhun gyis grub pa ste/ de lta bu'i skyes bu dam pa de rnams kyis thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i ye shes kyi mgon po chen po 'di la sgrub thabs kyi rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bzhugs na'ang*/ rtsa bar gyur pa ni/ drag po mthu sgrub dang*/ zhi ba nor sgrub gnyis lags/ de gnyis kyi yang gtso bo drag po mthu sgrub yin cing*/ 'di la yang bka' rigs mi gcig pa mang du yod na'ang*/ de rnams kyi rtsa ba'i dbang bka' ni bar chad kun sel gyi bka' 'di nyid yin pas/ 'di sgrub par byed pa la slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams sngon du song*/ slob ma'i ngo skal du gyur pa yang sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba la yang*/ maṇḍal 'bul ba/ gsol ba 'debs pa/ rtog pa bsdu ba/ thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs 'gro sems bskyed pa/
thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba gdab pa ste drug yod pa las/ dang po bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med pa'i spyan sngar ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur zhu ba'i don du maṇḍal phul mdzod/

ces brda sbyar slob ma rnams kyis shangs lugs maṇḍal bka' rgya ma'am/ mi shes na spyi 'gro zhig phul/ gnyis pa gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol// bdag ni 'gro la phan don du// gtso chen khyod la gsol 'debs kyi// mgon po'i dbang bskur bdag la stsol/ /lan gsum/ gsum pa rtog pa bsdu pa 'di gsan pas khyab bo// rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni// shin tu bsam pa bzang dang ldan pas nyon// brjed ngas blo la rdo rje sems dpa' sogs// bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlob// zhes de ltar na snod kyi skyon gsum spangs te gsan 'tshal/ bzhi pa khyad par can gyi skyabs 'gro'i (646)don ni/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med la skyabs su 'gro ba yin pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod// phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag rig pa 'dzin pa zhes bgyi ba/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i bla ma la skyabs su mchi/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas la= phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i chos la= phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun la= yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /lan gsum/ lnga pa rgyun bshags bya ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs gsum/ drug pa thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba gdab pa la yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pas mchod par bsam la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma dang myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po dbyer ma mchis pa la/ phyi me tog bdug spos/ nang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ gsang ba bde stong gi ye shes// yang gsang de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa dam pa rnams 'bul lo// bzhes nas bdag la dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur du gsol/

/lan gsum/ de dag gis dbang gi sbyor ba grub pa yin/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi dbang dngos bskur ba la yang*// ye shes dbab pa/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlab pa/ sku dngos kyis byin gyis brlab pa/ sngags gtad pa'i rjes gnang ste bzhi yod pa las/ dang po la dkyil 'khor du gzhug cing lha ngo bstan pa'i don dkyil 'khor gsal 'debs pa dang*/ ye shes phab pa dngos gnyis las/ dang po ni/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed dbyer ma mchis pa mgon po 'khor bcas gsal 'debs pa yin te/ khyed rang rnams kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang mi bzad pa'i dur khrod chen po'i (647)dbus su/ padma dang nyi ma'i steng du dpal tshogs kyi bdag po sku mdog dkar po glang po che'i dbu la spyan gsum la// phyag g.yas sa'i snying po la phug lo ma dang bcas pa zhal du gsol ba/ g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa nyal stabs su gnas pa/ de'i steng du myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa/ skye 'gro'i re ba tshul bzhin du skong ba/ sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin ltar rab tu gnag pa/ zhal gcig phyag drug pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'dril ba/ rab tu bzhed pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ dpral bar sindhū ra'i thig les byugs pa/ spyi bor mi bskyod rgyal pos rgyas btab pa/ phyag g.yas dang pos rdo rje gri gug dang*/ g.yon dang pos thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ g.yas bar pas thod skam gyi phreng ba/ tha mas ḍā ma ru drag tu 'khrol ba/ g.yon gnyis pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ tha ma na rdo rje zhags pa bsnams pa/ zhabs gnyis srid gsum rnam par gnon pa'i shugs can mnyam pa'i stabs krig krig zhabs kyis bgegs kyi rgyal po mnan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs la/

dar ljang gu'i ske rags bcings pa/ sbrul sngon pos dbu skra bcings shing*/ dmar pos snyan cha/ khra bos dpung rgyan/ dkar po'i mgul rgyan/ ser po'i lag gdub/ ljang gu'i do shal/ dkar po'i rkang gdub dang ska rags can/ phyag zhabs thams cad la dril bu g.yer kha'i phreng ba dang ldan pa/ sbom thung yan lag hrag pa/ gzi brjid mtha' yas pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan rin po che'i rtse bran can dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis mdzes pa/ (648)'jigs pa'i nga ro 'brug ltar sgrogs pa/ bdud dang bgegs thams cad brlag par mdzad pa/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing*/ tsandan gyi sdong po la rgyab brten pa'o// de'i g.yon du khrag zhag 'khrugs pa'i rgya mtsho'i dbus su/ dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ sku mdog nag mo phyag g.yas bdud kyi khram shing nag po phyar zhing*/ g.yon nad kyi rkyal pa 'dzin pa/ me rlung 'tshubs ma'i dbus na bzhugs shing*/ dre'u rta rkang gsum la chibs pa/ 'khor sha za dang ma mo mkha' 'gro 'bum sdes bskor ba'o// gtso bo'i mdun du gnod sbyin kṣe tra pa la/ sku mdog mthing nag kha gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs nas dgra la 'o dod 'bod pa/ shangs nas dus mtha'i rlung ldang ba/ phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la phyar bas lha dang lha ma yin thams cad skrag par byed pa/ g.yon thod khrag dgra bgegs kyi snying dang bcas pa zhal du stob cing dom nag smyon pa la chibs pa/ g.yas su dbang phyug dzi na mi tra sku mdog dkar nag g.yas ḍā ma ru 'khrol zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ rgyab tu gshin rje ṭākki rā dza sku mdog dkar nag /phyag g.yas zhags pa dgra la 'phen cing*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub gnod byed la sdigs pa/ g.yon du bdud mgon chen po trakshad sku mdog nag po phyag g.yas su mtshon mdung dmar rtse gsum pa dgra po'i snying gar bsnun pa/

g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba bsnams pa/ ya sos ma mchu mnan pa/ dar nag gi 'jol ber dang*/ sag ti'i lh+wam yu ring gsol ba/ gser gyi ske rags bcings pa/ bdud rta nag po rting dkar la chibs pa/ bzhi ka'ang khro bo'i las mkhan gyi cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa'o// de'i phyi rol du shar du brgya byin/ shar lhor me lha/ lhor gshin rje/ lho nub tu srin po/ nub tu (649)chu lha/ nub byang du rlung lha/ byang du gnod sbyin/ byang shar du 'byung po/ steng du tshangs pa/ 'og tu bdag ste phyogs skyong bcu/ gzhan yang lha chen po brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/ gza' chen po brgyad/ 'jigs byed chen po dgu/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ rgyal po chen po bzhi ste/ gtsang rigs gyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga po thams cad kyang 'khor bye ba bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs sha la dga' ba/ khrag la rol pa/ snying rje med pa/ kha gdangs pa/ mig rtsa dmar ba/ lag na gdug pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa skad cig la skye 'gro thams cad kyi srog dbugs sdud pa/ gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po dang*/ gshin rje dang*/ bdud dang ma mo'i cha lugs can/ sa gzhi bar snang nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad yongs su gang ba/ thams cad kyang sgrub pa po'i re 'dod tshul bzhin du skong bar mdzad pa'o// de lta bu'i bla ma mgon po dbyer med pa la/ mos gus dung pa byas pas thugs ka nas 'od zer bun gyis 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs/ ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad sbyangs nas 'od phung du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nyid la slob dpon gyis/ oṃ swā bhā lba nas haṃ/ zhes brjod pas 'od gsal stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong nyid de'i ngang las khyed rang rnams kyi go sar pam̐ las padma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du/ gaṃ dkar po 'od du zhu ba las dpal tshogs kyi bdag po sku mdog dkar po glang po che'i dbu la spyan gsum pa phyag g.yas sa'i snying po la phug lo ma dang bcas pa zhal du gsol ba/

g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa nyal stabs su gnas pa/ de'i steng du khyed rang rnams kyi sems nyid hūm̐ mthing nag las gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer (650)'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ khyed rang rnams myur mdzad ye shes mgon po sogs nas/ tsandan gyi sdong po la rgyab brten pa'o// de ltar gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ shar lho dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal// tsandan gyi shing rkang gcig pa'i drung nas myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa/ steng na rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ g.yas na dpa' bo ngar dang bcas shing*/ g.yon na dpa' mo 'dzum dang bcas pa/ bka' sdod zhing skyong pho nya/ dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad skad cig nyid la/ ḍā ma ru dang dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra si li li/ khro lo lo/ 'ur 'ur chem chem byon te khyed rang rnams kyi lus la gnyis su med par thim/ rol mo'i sgra cher bya/ dam rdzas spos kyi dud pa brtul/ oṃ badzra ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra kṣiṃ kṣiṃ kṣiṃ sogs nyer gcig /kṣiṃ gyi gnas su e hye hi bcug pa dang*/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ bcug pa rnams lan gsum gsum/ myur mdzad 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ slob ma'i lus la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim par gyur/ zhes brjod de ye shes dbab pa'i rim pa'o/ /gnyis pa sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlab pa'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ bla ma dang mdun bskyed mgon po dbyer ma mchis pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ mthing ga gsal btab la/ dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur du gsol/

khyad par bum pa'i dbang bskur du gsol snyam pa'i yid kyis gsol ba dung dung btab pas/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par tshur bsdus te oṃ la thim/ oṃ las 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa byung ste khyed rang rnams kyi dpral ba'i oṃ la thim pas bum dbang thob (651)pa'i mos pa mdzod/ brjod la rol mo bya/ yang gsang dbang bskur du gsol/ mgrin pa'i āḥgasung gi byin rlabs/ mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od zer dmar po/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa'i āḥl thim pas gsang dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ /ces 'don 'gyur rigs 'gre/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur du gsol/ thugs ka'i hūm̐/ thugs kyi byin rlabs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer mthing ga/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim pas/ sher dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang dbang bzhi pa bskur du gsol snyam pa dang*/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med la mos gus dung ba byas pas/ gnas gsum gyi yi ge 'bru gsum po de nyid rgyangs kyis chad nas byon/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum yi ge 'bru gsum la thim/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga'i hūm̐ mgrin pa'i āḥl thim/ de yang spyi bo'i oṃ la thim/ oṃ yang nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin du gyur/ des lus ngag yid gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa'i sgrib pa dag nas/ dbang bzhi pa thob pa yin pas/ sems spros bral phyag rgya chen po la zhog mdzod/ rol mo/ gsum pa sku dngos kyi byin gyis brlab pa ni/ gtor ma 'di nyid myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po 'khor bcas su gsal ba la mos gus dung pa byas pas/ 'ur 'ur chem chem rang gi spyi bor byon/ bla mas khyed rang rnams kyi bar chad bsrung ba dang*/ mthun rkyen sgrub par bka' bsgos pa'i tshe/ khyed rang rnams kyi nad gdon dgra bgegs thams cad mgon po'i zhal du sha chom rus chom du gsol zhing*/

rigs kyi bu khyod kyi bar chad bsrung ba dang*/ mthun rkyen sgrub par ngas bya'o// zhes gsung lhang lhang byon par bsgom mdzod/ ces gtor ma slob ma'i spyi bor bzung la/ rol mo dang bcas pas bka' bsgo ba ni/ mgon po 'khor bcas kyi sngags brjod pa'i mthar/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po nag po chen po phyag drug pa/ (652)ma gcig 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ 'khor gnod sbyin kṣe tra pā la/ dbang phyug dzi na mi tra/ gshin rje ṭākki rā dza/ bdud mgon trakshad nag po/ phyogs skyong bcu/ gtsang rigs kyi dpal mgon bdun cu/ dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs dang bcas pa/ khyed rnams kyis rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po/ dpal ldan sha ba ri dbang phyug /grub chen mai tri pa chen po/ rā hu la gupta/ mkhas grub khyung po lo tsā ba/ rmog lcog pa rin chen brtson 'grus/ skyer sgang pa ye shes seng ge /gnyan ston spas pa'i rnal 'byor/ chos rje sangs rgyas ston pa/ shangs ston rin chen 'bum/ khyung po tshul khrims snying po/ grub chen sangs rgyas seng ge /mkhas btsun shangs dkar ba rin chen rgyal mtshan// lkug lung pa sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ grub dbang nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rgya sgom legs pa rgyal mtshan/ rnal 'byor sems kyi mdud 'grol/ chos sku lha dbang grags pa/ rje btsun sgrol ba'i mgon po/ kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ rwa pa ngag dbang phrin las/ chos rje kun bzang dbang po/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu/ bka' brgyud phrin las shing rta/ bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma/ bka' brgyud phrin las rnam rgyal/ rtsa ba'i bla ma byams mgon rdo rje 'chang padma nyin byed dbang po'i bar du byon pa'i dpal ldan bla ma de rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ rdo rje slob ma 'di dag gi lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs la/ 'gal rkyen nad gdon bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang*/

mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams 'khor dang longs spyod thams cad rgyas pa dang*/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'gro ba thams cad dbang du 'du ba dang*/ dgra dang bgegs la sogs pa'i gnod byed thams cad tshar gcod pa dang*/ mdor na byang chub ma thob gyi bar du bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa dang*/ sba (653)ba'i phrin las mdzad nas/ mi 'dod pa thams cad sol/ 'dod don thams cad sgrubs/ ji ltar bcol pa'i las thams cad la thogs pa med par mdzod cig /bzhi pa sngags lung gi don du slob dpon gyis mdun bskyed la gsol ba lan gsum 'debs dgos pa yin te/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyis kyang*/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med pa'i thugs kar pad nyi la hūm̐ gi mthar snying po dang rtsa sngags kyi bskor bar bsgom la/ mos gus dung pa dang bcas me tog 'thor bzhin du 'di'i rjes mdzod// bcom ldan bdag la stsal= bdag la= lan gsum/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med pa'i thugs ka'i sngags phreng me 'od rab tu 'bar ba'i 'od zer dmar nag 'phro ba de dag las/ sngags phreng mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du chad de zhal nas 'thon/ khyed rang rnams dang por gsal ba'i zhal nas zhugs/ snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ gi mthar sngags thams cad mdog nag po 'od zer dmar nag me 'od du 'phro bas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sreg par byed pa dang bcas pa'i sngags phreng sgor gyis byung ba'i mos pa dang bcas pas 'di'i rjes zlos oṃ badzra ma hā kā la kṣiṃ kṣe tra bi ghnan bi nā ya ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/

lan gsum/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la shā sa na/ u pa ha ri ṇi/ e ṣo3 pashtsi ma/ kā lo3 yaṃ i daṃ/ ratna tra yā ya/ a ba ka ri ṇi/ ya ti pra ti dzñā/ sma ra si tā dā/ i daṃ duṣṭaṃ/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mā ra mā ra/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa/ bandha bandha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum/ oṃ shrī de wī hūm̐ phaṭa/ gsum/ oṃ kṣe tra pā la bighnān hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dzi na mi tra ba shaṃ ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ṭākki rā dza sa ma ya bhyoḥdu dza hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ du yo ga dza hā kā la trakshad hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa rnams kyang lan gsum gsum bzla'o/ /mthar slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sngags phreng de nyid rgyangs kyis chad nas byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim pas/ bla ma mgon po'i byin rlabs mtha' dag gis brgyud brlan par mos pa mdzod/ de (654)yan gyis dngos gzhi grub zin/ gsum pa rjes la/ dam tshig bzung ba/ yon dbul ba/ smon lam gdab pa ste gsum las/ dang po ni/ deng phyin chad khyed rnams kyis yongs su blangs pa'i bslab pa thams cad rnam par dag pa dang*/ khyad par sems bskyed kyi bslab bya dang*/ sngags kyi dam tshig mtha' dag ma nyams pa gal che/ yang dgos mgon po nyid kyi dam tshig 'bru nag rjen btags kyi gtor ma dang*/ dam rdzas kyi spos sbyor ma chad par gyis/ bya nag dang*/ khyi nag la rdo mi rdeg yid ches par gyis la/ bla ma dang dbyer med du ltos/ 'byung po gzhan la zas phud mi 'bul/ sdig can gtum po grogs su mi bsten/ khyad par chos skyong 'di nyid gsang ba dang*/ sngags dang man ngag gsang ba dang*/ dus rgyun dang khyad par gyi mchod gtor la brtson pa gal che ba lags so// de dag gi gnas skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa srung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos sogs bya/ gnyis pa gtang rag gi maṇḍal phul/ 'di'i rjes zlos kyang mdzod/

deng nas brtsams te sogs gsum bya/ gsum pa chos gsan pa'i dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs sam/ bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams sogs smon lam ci rigs par brjod do// 'dir bde mchog lha lnga ltar tshogs byin rlabs nas lhag ma'i bar btang*/ de nas rjes kyi mchod pa bsham/ spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ arghaṃ nas shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis mchod phul/ chos dbyings ngang las sogs kyis bstod/ yig brgya mang du bzlas/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang*/ zhes sogs dang*/ ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang dang*// gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas// 'dir ni bya ba gang bgyis pa// de kun khyed kyis bzod par rigs// bla ma mgon po dbyer med la// bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi// nyon mongs ma lus (655)sel bar shog /oṃ/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// gtor ma'i ye shes pa bris sku'i thugs kar thim/ oṃ badzra muḥ gtor mgron rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar thim par gyur/ /ces mos/ slar gtor ma gong ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ bris sku'i lha la gtor chog bzhin phul nas/ bris sku la brtan bzhugs bya/ smon lam btab la/ yon tan rab rdzogs gangs kyi ri bo bzhin// byin rlabs chu bos skal ldan tshim mdzad cing*// rang sems lhan cig skyes pa ston mdzad pa'i// chos rje bla ma mchog gi bkra shis shog /sgrub pa po la bu bzhin gzigs mdzad cing*// mi 'bral lus dang grib ma ji bzhin du// dam tshig can la dngos grub ster mdzad pa'i// yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog /dam can sgrub pa po yi rjes 'brang zhing*// zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang mngon spyod sogs// sna tshogs phrin las tshul bzhin sgrub mdzad pa'i// chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog

/snang srid rang grol sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin// bde ba chen po rgyun chad med pa'i nyams// yid la byar med stong gsal nam mkha'i ngang*// bde chen phyag rgya chen po'i= sgrub pa po la brten cing mchod pa dang*// skur pa 'debs pa'i skye 'gro gang yin pa// thams cad byang chub lam la 'god mdzad pa'i// mnyam med byang chub sems kyi= 'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa thams cad kyi// bkra shis go 'phang ji snyed yod pa rnams// phun sum tshogs pa chu bo'i gzhung bzhin du// skye 'gro yongs la rtag tu= bsod nams dar rgyas ri rgyal lhun po bzhin// snyan grags chen po nam mkha' bzhin du khyab// tshe ring nad med gzhan don lhun gyis grub// yon tan rgya mtsho mchog gi bkra shis (656)shog /ces bkra shis bka' rgya ma brjod do// yang 'di dag la lag len mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni/ bla ma'i gnas gsum gyi yig 'bru gsum las mgon po dkar dmar mthing gsum spro ba dang*/ bzhi pa la sku'i stod smad thams cad nas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs spro ba yang lugs gcig yin/ yang yi ge 'bru gsum spro bas dbang gsum byed pa'ang yod cing*/ sku spro ba'i dbang bzhi/ gsung yig 'bru'i dbang bzhi/ thugs 'od zer gyi dbang bzhi/ yon tan gtor ma'i dbang bzhi/ phrin las phyag mtshan gyi dbang bzhi/ zhes ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang nyi shu bskur ba ni/ zhang sgom chen po'i thun mong ma yin pa'i lugs yin la/ tshul de bzhin ma shes par gtor dbang dkyus 'gro zhig gi gzhug tu phyag mtshan drug gi rjes gnang tsam byed pa ni snying po med do// mgon po stod lugs lha dgu ma la/ gnas rnying ba phyi ma 'gas gsar rnying gi cho ga ci rigs la brten nas dbang chog rgyas pa sbyar ba ni rang bzor byas la/ de'i yig rnying khung ma rnams phal cher 'di nyid dang mthun pas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang gi cho ga 'di kho nas bya'o// rjes chog gi skabs bris 'bur sogs rten ye med na/

gtor ma'i lha dam ye ma phye bar nam mkhar spar la/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs te phul nas/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bsdu ba yin no// bstan srung kun las chos lhag pa'i// phyag drug mgon po'i byin rlabs kyi// lag len rab tu dga' ba'i tog /snying po tsam zhig gsal bar bkod/ ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa bar chad kun sel gyi byin rlabs kyi lag len gsal bar bshad pa'i le tshan no// maṅga laṃ// // ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ bshad ma thag pa'i byin rlabs zab mo de ni brgyud 'dzin thun mong min pa las gzhan du bya ba ma yin la/ thun mong ba la mi zab pa'i lugs kyi gtor dbang dkyus mthun tsam byed na/ bsham sngar dang 'dra/ gtor ma lhar bskyed tshul la gtor ma'i steng du mgon po bskyed pa dang*/ gtor ma nyid bskyed pa gnyis yod pa/ gtor dbang gi tshe zab mi zab khyad par chen po yod pa 'dor len gal che bas skabs 'dir steng du bskyed/ rjes gnang sngon 'gro'i skabs thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol gdab mi byed/ dngos gzhi'i skabs mdun bskyed la ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa tsam las/ slob ma la mgon po bskyed bstim mi byed/ dbang bzhi pa'i skabs slob dpon gyi gnas gsum nas/ yig 'bru gnyis pa (657) chad de bstim/ slob ma'i yig 'bru gsum 'od gsal du bsdu ba mi byed/ /lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs/ zhes pa dang*/ ji ltar bcol pa'i las sogs mi sbyar/ gong gi dmigs pa'i tshe/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyi sogs zhal bzhes dmigs pa mi sbyar/ sngags kyi bzlas lung mi byed pa'am/ byed kyang dkyus mthun tsam byed pa ni/ gtor dbang bar chad kun sel bsdus pa'am/ thun mong ba dkyus ma yin no// khyad par chos brgyud sel yod pa dang*/ chos sgor ma zhugs pa'i khyim pa la/ gtor dbang zab mo'i lugs su bskur ba ni/ tshe 'dir yang bskur bar bya ba'i yul la mi phan zhing*/ rang la bka' chad rin gyis nyo ba yin pas/

rnyed bkur la sogs pa'i don du gtor dbang tsam byed na'ang*/ mi zab pa'i lugs de nyid la tshig tshogs kyi sgros pa dang bcas pa byas na 'khu ldog chung ba yin/ spyir gsang sgrogs kyi nyes pa la ni khyad cher med do// gtso rkyang 'jam zhing 'khor can bka' gnyan pa yin pas/ gtso rkyang la brten nas gtor dbang byed na'ang de'i 'dor len shes par bya'o// 'di la rje btsun rin po ches rjes gnang zab pa dang mi zab pa'i lugs zhes pa tsam las rnam grangs so sor bgrang bar ma mdzad kyang*/ mkhas grub rjes snga ma la rjes gnang bar chad kun sel dang*/ phyi ma la gtor dbang bar chad kun sel ces tha snyad dang rnam grangs so sor mdzad pa/ snga ma thob pa la phyi ma zur du bskur mi dgos kyang bskur yul gyi dbye ba phyed pa la zur du bgrang na go bde bar snang ba dang*/ bka' chen bcu gsum du 'dren pa'i skabs rnam grangs su bgrang bar snang bas zur du bkol ba'o// maṅga laṃ// ༈ //oṃ swa sti/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med ni// dbang gi rgyal po zhes grags la// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas la btud de// yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs bri// mgon bka' gnyis pa mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs dang*/ rjes gnang byed tshul yang snying du dril ba ni/ mdun du stegs bu'i steng du/ rdul tshon gyis maṇḍal zlum po mu khyud dkar po/ dbus su chos 'byung dkar po/ re khā dmar/ grub bcad ljang gu/ chos 'byung gi dbus su nyi gdan la tshom bu dkar po zhig bkod/ de'i steng du mañdzi la rten (658) gyi gtor ma rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa zhig bkod de/ dbyibs gru gsum du byed pa'am/ nor bu'i dbyibs su byed na/ zan zlum po'i steng du/ zan ril gsum 'dzom/ de'i steng du dzaṃ bshos 'dra ba zhig bkod pas/ phyogs gang nas bltas kyang nor bu mig gsum 'dra ba zhig yong bas de ltar byas kyang rung*/

gang ltar na'ang rgyu phye mar la rin po che brdar ba sogs las byas/ maṇḍal kyi mdun du 'bul gtor zlum po zas bzang dgus brgyan pa dang*/ mchod pa rnams spyi dang mthun par bsham/ rten gtor la tsa ka li yod na 'thugs shing med kyang chog /de nas mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun par byas la/ dngos gzhi nyams len ni/ bdag bskyed yi dam la bya ba'i lugs kyang yod med kyi 'di la bdag mdun dbyer med gtso che zhig phyag len yang bdag mdun dbyer med pa mdzad de/ de ltar na skyabs 'gro sems bskyed chad med bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ shū n+ya ta sa stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su/ paṃ las padma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du/ gaṃ las tshogs bdag dkar po glang po che'i gdong pa can/ la phug dang*/ ne'u le 'dzin pa gnyis kha bub tu bsgyel ba'i steng du/ rang sems chos nyid kyi thig le dkar dmar rgya sran tsam/ de'i dbus su hūm̐ dngul chu'i mdog lta bu/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi dbul ba'i sdug bsngal bsal/ slar 'dus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang dang mdun bskyed dbyer ma mchis pa/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po yid bzhin gyi nor bu dbang gi rgyal po'i skur gyur pa ni/ sku mdog dkar zhing brjid pa/ zhal khro 'dzum gyi rnam pa can rab tu bzhad pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing*/ sma ra smin ma/ dbu skra kham ser brdzes pa/ dpral bar sin dhū ra'i thig les byugs pa/ spyi bor mi bskyod rgyal pos rgyas btab pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos gri gug nam mkha' la phyar ba/ bar pas nor bu dbang gi rgyal po thugs kar gtod pa/ tha mas seng ldeng gi ḍā ma ru 'khrol ba/ g.yon gyi dang pos bum pa (659)nor bus gang ba ka pā la bdud rtsi'i gang ba'i nang du bcug ste brla g.yon pa la brten pa/ gnyis pa na rtse gsum/

tha ma na zhags pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs 'gro 'cham kyi stabs kyis pad nyi tshogs bdag gi gdan la bzhugs pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi lhab lhub dang*/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ glang po che'i pags pa'i stod g.yogs gsol ba/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rin po che'i rgyan dang sil khrol dang*/ chun 'phyang sna tshogs pas mdzes pa/ 'khor dbang sdud kyi mkha' 'gro ma bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs kyis bskor te me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de nas dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥthugs kar dbang sdud kyi mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo lcags kyu dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ de'i thugs kar chos nyid kyi thig le/ de'i dbus su hūm̐ dkar po'o// rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ shar lho dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal nas myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po yid bzhin nor bu mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad badzra sa mā dzaḥ padma ka ma la ye st+waṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ arghaṃ nas/ shabda 'i bar gyis mchod/ mgon po yid bzhin nor bu thugs rje can// sku mdog gangs ri ltar dkar 'od zer 'phro// 'gro ba'i dbul phongs ma lus zhi mdzad pa// 'dod dgu'i dngos grub stsol la phyag 'tshal bstod// snying ga'i thig le'i mtha' bskor du sngags kyis bskor bar bsams la/ gu ru ma hā kā la ha ri ni sa siddhi dzaḥ ces ci nus su bzla/ gtor ma bsang sbyang nag po'i mngon rtogs su bshad pa ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ ye shes sems dpa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma drangs nas gsol bar gyur/ snying po'i mthar i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes btags pa lan bdun gyis 'bul zhing*/ shā sa na lan gsum gyis dam can spyi la 'bul ba phyag len la mdzad/ de nas gong bzhin mchod bstod/ mchod (660)sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ sogs kyis 'dod don la gsol ba btab/

rang nyid sgrub pa nyams len tsam yin na/ skabs 'dir rjes chog bya/ slob ma rjes bzung ni/ rjes chog gi sngon du bya ba yin te/ slob ma rnams la chab btang*/ me tog bkye bsdu bya/ sems bskyed gsal btab/ rgyas par spro na chos bshad mgon pos thugs bskyed pa'i lo rgyus sogs rgyas par bshad/ bsdu na/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i ma gyur skye dgu mtha' dag gi ched du bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i bka' zab mo zhus la don nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i thugs bskyed gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la gsan bya'i gdams ngag /gangs can gyi ljongs su grags che ba'i sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad kyi ring lugs las ches zab cing ngo mtshar du gyur pa dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud la khyad par can gyi chos skyong gcig chog kho nar bzhugs pa ni myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po nyid yin te/ de'ang 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug nyid thugs bskyed dang thugs dam khyad par can gyi dbang gis drag por khros pa'i skur bzhengs shing*/ bstan srung kun gyi dbang phyug tu phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams kyis dbang bskur zhing mnga' gsol/ grub chen sha ba ri/ mai tri pa/ rā hu la gupta/ grub thob chen po khyung po rnal 'byor sogs dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi skyes chen dam pa rim par byon pa rnams kyis zhal gzigs shing grub par mdzad/ de lta bu'i dpal ye shes kyi mgon po la sgrub skor rim pa mang por bzhugs na'ang*/ rtsa bar gyur pa/ drag po mthu sgrub dang*/ zhi ba nor sgrub gnyis su 'du/ dang po la'ang gtso rkyang lcam dral/ lha gsum/ dregs pa sde lngas bskor ba sogs dang*/ gzhan yang gtso 'khor gyi drag sgrub mang por bshad pa dang*/ zhi ba nor sgrub la/ mgon dkar/ mgon ser/ mgon dmar/

(661)mgon ljang tshe bdag la sogs pa nang gses dang bcas pa bzhugs pa las/ drag sgrub kyi skor ni gtso bor mnga' bdag mai tri pa chen po las mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor gyis gsan par snang zhing*/ zhi sgrub kyi skor ni gtso bor grub chen rā hu la gupta badzra'i zhal snga nas gsan par snang ste/ de'ang mkhas grub khyung po nyid 'phan yul kyog por chig rir mdzad pa'i skabs shig lon pa'i skyil po dgon par sku mtshams mdzad pa'i tshe/ 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku brnyes pa'i grub chen rā hu la chen po de nyid ched du phebs nas rdzu 'phrul bkod pa ngo mtshar ba bstan/ rgyud dang gdams ngag spyi dang khyad par du gyur pa'i smin grol mtha' yas pa rnams dang*/ khyad par myur mdzad ye shes mgon po'i chos skor sngar grags pa dang ma grags pa mang du gnang ba'i zhi ba nor sgrub kyi skor las/ mgon po yid bzhin nor bu 'di ni mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyi snying nas skul ba'i man ngag /gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis mchog dang thun mong gnyis ka 'byung ba/ dbang bskur thob pa tsam gyis kyang dngos grub sna re thob pa/ yig cha 'chang ba tsam gyis longs spyod rang bzhin gyis 'du ba'i sgrub thabs khyad par du 'phags pa 'di nyid kyi rjes gnang byin rlabs kyi rim pa bsgrub par bgyi ba la slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams sngon tu grub zin pa lags pas khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/

ces mtshams sbyar nas maṇḍal 'bul du gzhug cing*/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ byas la/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol/ ces sogs lan gsum/ rtog pa bsdu ba/ thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs 'gro/ rgyun bshags yan lag lnga pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol gdab rnams phyag len rgyas pa'i tshe mdzad cing*/ mdor bsdus pa la dga' na/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum rjes zlos byed du gzhug /rjes gnang dngos (662)gzhi la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ ces brda sprad la/ mdun gyi gtor ma dang slob dpon dbyer ma mchis pa mgon po yid bzhin nor bur gsal gdab dgos pa yin pas spyan dmigs 'di bzhin tu mdzad 'tshal/ oṃ shū n+ya ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang zhes pa nas bzhugs pa'o bar gong bzhin/ de lta bu'i slob dpon dang mdun bskyed dbyer ma mchis pa la mos gus dung ba byas pas/ oṃshū n+ya nas/ ko3haṃ/ zhes gsungs pa'i rkyen gyis kun rdzob rnam shes kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang rnams kyi sems nyid thig le hūm̐ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po yid bzhin gyi nor bu dbang gi rgyal po'i skur khrong gis gyur bar mos mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ/ zhes pa nas/ hūm̐ dkar po'o// slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros shar lho dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal nas/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po yid bzhin gyi nor bu mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs te/ skad cig de nyid la ḍā ma ru dang dril bu g.yer kha sil sil/ khrol khrol/ 'ur 'ur/ chem chem byon te/ khyed rang la gnyis su med par thim/ zhes brjod la rol mo drag tu bya/ snying po'i mthar a we sha ya aḥ zhes drag tu bzla/

rol mo dang sngags bzlas ni 'og ma rnams la yang rigs 'gre/ de sku'i rjes gnang bum dbang gi dod yin no// slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i chos nyid kyi thig le'i nang hūm̐ gi mtha' bskor du sngags kyis bskor bar mos/ slob dpon la mos gus dung pa byas pas/ thugs ka'i sngags phreng las sngags phreng gnyis pa zhig chad/ zhal nas 'thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs snying ga'i chos nyid kyi thig le'i nang du sbar btab pa bzhin du 'khod par mos la/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ snying po (663) lan bcu gsum bzla ba phyag len la mdzad de gsung gi rjes gnang gsang dbang yin no// yang slob dpon la mos gus dung pa byas pas/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje'i byin rlabs ma lus pa tshur bsdus te thugs kar thim/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las/ gri gug /thod pa/ bum pa/ nor bu/ lcags kyu la sogs pa'i phyag mtshan dpag tu med pa byung*/ thams cad 'od du zhu nas khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim/ rol mo/ de thugs kyi rjes gnang shes rab ye shes kyi dod yin/ yang slob dpon la mos gus dung pa byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga sku mdog dmar mo ḍā ma ru dang thod pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros/ shangs kyi bu ga g.yon pa nas 'thon/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gang*/ 'khor 'das snod bcud thams cad kyi bkrag mdangs bcud/ dwangs ma/ tshe srog /longs spyod/ dbang thang thams cad bdud rtsi'i rnam par tshur 'dus/ khyed rang rnams kyi sna bug g.yon pa nas zhugs/ srog rtsa'i lam nas brgyud de/ snying ga'i chos nyid kyi thig le la gnyis su med par thim/ rol mo/ de yon tan gyi rjes gnang dbang bzhi pa'i dod yin no// yang slob dpon la mos gus dung pa byas pas/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi zhabs 'og gi tshogs bdag bskul bas tshogs bdag las rang dang 'dra ba'i tshogs dpag tu med pa sprul/

'byung po mi dang mi ma yin dregs ldan che dgu thams cad dbang du bsdus/ khyed rang rnams kyi bran du phul ba'i mos pa mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi rkang 'og gi tshogs kyi bdag po'i kha dang bshang lam ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i char chen po babs pas/ (664)rang gi bang mdzod gnas khang yul phyogs thams cad zas nor longs spyod/ 'dod dgu sna tshogs pas phyur bur gang bar gyur/ rol mo/ de phrin las kyi rjes gnang dbang gi mtha' brten gyi dod yin no// phrin las gtor ma'i bka' bsgo ba ni/ mos pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ gtor ma 'di nyid bla ma mgon po dbyer med/ mgon dkar yid bzhin gyi nor bu mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs dang bcas par gsal btab/ de rnams la mos gus dung pa byas pas/ 'ur 'ur/ chem chem/ rang gi spyi bor byon/ rang gi yid la ji ltar 'dod pa'i don thams cad sgrub par bya'o// zhes gsung lhang lhang byon par bsam zhing*/ byin gyis rlob rlob ltar bzhugs par gyur/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ dpal myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po yid bzhin nor bu dbang gi rgyal po 'khor mkha' 'gro ma bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen/ 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang*/ grub chen rā hu la gupta/ mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor nas rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang padma nyin byed dbang po'i bar du byon pa'i bka' brgyud grub pa'i dbang phyug rnams kyi bka' dang tha tshig gi rim pa bsnyel bar ma mdzad par/ dam tshig dang ldan pa'i rdo rje'i slob ma 'di la lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs la/ dus da nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob kyi bar du mchog thun mong gi dngos grub rtsol ba med par yid bzhin du 'grub pa sogs ci ltar bcol ba'i phrin las ma lus pa thogs med du bsgrub par mdzad du gsol/ ces bka' bsgo drag tu bya/

mthar bla ma mgon po dbyer med 'od du zhu nas/ khyed rang rnams la thim par mos pa mdzod byas la/ de dag gi gnas skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig dang*/ zhes pa nas/ spyad du gsol zhes pa'i bar nag po'i rjes gnang gi skabs dang (665) 'dra/ rjes kyi cho ga rnams kyang mgon po nag po dang 'dra zhing*/ 'di nyid kyi rjes chog gi skabs gtor ma'i ye shes pa nam mkhar btegs nas/ gtor ma de nyid dbul ba'i lag len yang 'dug mod kyi mgon dkar gyi phyag len dkyus la mi mdzad par snang ngo*// nor sgrub kun las ches lhag pa// dga' bar bsngags pa'i g.yer po che// mkha' 'gro'i snying nas bskul ba'i thabs// gsal por brjod 'di e ma mtshar// mgon dkar yid bzhin kyi nor bu'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ /na mo gu ru/ rgyal ba kun gyi bla ma ni// rgyal sras gzhon nu'i tshul 'dzin pa// 'jig rten mgon la rab btud nas// mgon ser sgrub thabs bshad par bya// mgon bka' gsum pa mgon ser zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang lag tu blang ba'i rim pa ni/ gtor ma gru gsum ser po'am/ nor bu 'bar ba'i gzugs can zhig bya/ chos 'byung ser po gru gsum gyi steng du mañdzi la 'god pa sogs bsham gzhan dang 'dra/ mchod pa byin rlabs dang*/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi rnams spyi dang 'dra/ shū n+ya ta sa stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su pad nyi la tshogs bdag pho mo bsgyel ba'i steng du/ hūm̐ ser po yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid dpal ye shes kyi mgon po sku mdog ser la cung zad dmar ba'i mdangs can/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa zhal ser ba/ g.yas zhal dkar ba/ g.yon zhal dmar ba/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du 'khyil ba/ phyag g.yas g.yon gyi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod khrag thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/

g.yas kyi gnyis pa na rgyal mtshan/ gsum pa na utpal/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na ne'u le dang*/ gsum pa na zhags pa bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis tshogs bdag pho mo mnan pa/ sku la dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs pa/ (666)yum lha mo drag mo sku mdog dud kha gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal nas/ myur mdzad 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrang dang gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ gu ru ma hā kā la kṣiṃ uṣṇi ṣa ya yakṣa hūm̐/ ratna gṛ siddhi hūm̐/ pra dzñā wardha ni swā hā// // a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ swa bhā lba sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las zhes pa nas/ dbu brgyan gyi bar bdag bskyed dang 'dra ba las/ rang sems zhes dang*/ rang nyid ces pa bor ba ni khyad par ro/ /arghaṃ nas/ shabda 'i bar gyis mchod/ byad ma zlog cing bsrung ba dang*// tshe dang blo gros kun 'phel zhing*// zhi dang rgyas pa'i las mdzad pa// bla ma mgon po khyod la 'dud/ /mdun bskyed la dmigs nas bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ gtor ma byin rlabs nag po'i mngon rtogs dang mtshungs/ oṃ gu ru ma hā kā la i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan bdun gyis phul/ gong ltar mchod bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab/ slob dpon gyi bya ba'o// slob ma rnams kyis yon dbul ba la sogs pa'i sngon 'gro'i bya ba mgon po dkar nag gnyis kyi rjes gnang dang 'dra ba las/

sems bskyed gsal btab skabs/ bcom ldan 'das mgon ser zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i bka' zab mo zhes dang*/ gsan bya'i chos grub chen rā hu la chen pos mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor la stsal ba'i myur (667)mdzad ye shes mgon po/ zhi ba nor sgrub kyi skor las yon tan gyi mgon po ser po 'di ni/ spyir byad kha rbod gtong srung zhing zlog pa dang*/ zhi ba dang rgyas pa'i las rab 'byams 'grub par byed cing*/ khyad par 'chi med rdo rje'i tshe dang*/ chags thogs med pa'i blo gros kyi stobs 'phel ba zab cing myur ba'i mthu dang ldan pa 'di nyid kyi rjes gnang sogs sbyar la/ gsol gdab sogs grub bdas/ rjes gnang dngos la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ ces byas la/ bla ma mgon ser du gsal ba'i zhal nas/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes gsungs pa'i rkyen gyis ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad dbyings su sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las nas dbu brgyan gyi bar sgrub thabs dang 'dra ba las rang sems ces pa/ khyed rang rnams kyi ces pa dang*/ rang nyid ces pa khyed rang rnams ces 'don pa spo/ ye shes pa spyan drangs te badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pa'i mthar/ rol chen bya zhing*/ snying po'i mthar a we sha ya a/ zhes brjod pa rnams ni khyad par ro/ /bla ma'i dpral ba nas oṃ yig dkar po byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral bar thim/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ mgrin pa nas āḥyig dmar po byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par thim/ gsang dbang thob/ thugs ka nas hūm̐ yig sngon po byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ gnas gsum char nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ dkar dmar mthing gsum byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du thim/ dbang bzhi pa thob par mos pa mdzod/ 'di la sngags kyi bzlas lung mi dgos/ phrin las gtor ma'i bka' bsgo ba ni/

gtor ma 'di nyid bla ma mgon po dbyer med du gsal ba'i mtha' bskor du sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor bar mos/ rang gi spyi bor byon/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi sku phra mo dpag tu med pa (668)byung ste/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ byas la/ dpal myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po ser po yum lha mo drag mo sprul pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen sogs mgon dkar ltar la/ thogs med du bsgrub pa dang*/ khyad par byad kha rbod gtong phas rgol gyi dmod ngan thams cad zlog cing srung ba dang*/ 'chi ba med pa'i tshe dang chags thogs med pa'i blo gros yar zla ltar 'phel ba dang*/ chags che nyam nga mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi zhing 'byor pa drug dang nyams rtogs kyi yon tan gong nas gong du rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /ces rol chen dang bcas te bka' bsgo drag tu bya/ rjes kyi bya ba dam tshig bsrung bar khas blang ba sogs dang rjes 'og mi mgon po nag po'i rjes gnang gi yi ger bris zin pa 'don pa spos la sbyar bar bya'o// mgon ser 'di'ang*/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med ser po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa gnyis la mgon ser bka' gnyis zhes zer na'ang*/ mgon ser dngos ni 'di kho na'o// nor 'phel bsrung ba kun gyi mchog /shes rab dga' ba skyed byed pa// mgon ser sgrub thabs rmad byung ba// shin tu dkon pas snying por dril// mgon ser blo 'phel gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ na mo gu ru/ spyan ras gzigs dbang khro bo'i sku// dbang sdud lha la gus phyag 'tshal lo// padma rā ga'i 'od 'phro ba// mgon po'i sgrub thabs bri bar bya// mgon bkar bzhi pa mgon dmar dbang gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi rim pa ni/ mdun du stegs bu// maṇḍal gru gsum mthing nag me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su/

padma dmar po 'dab brgyad kyi lte ba la/ rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ dang*/ gri gug gi lte bar āḥs mtshan pa/ de tsam 'bri ma thub na tshom bu dmar po bkod/ de'i steng du mañdzi la thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i steng du/ me long la sindhū ra btsag la bkram/ de la chos 'byung gru gsum gnyis brtsegs dbus su rdo rje hūm̐ dang*/ gri gug āḥs mtshan pa/ zur drug po la g.yas bskor gyis ha ri ni sa swā hā/ zhes pa'i yi ge drug po rnams bri/ steng du dar dmar po'i gur phub/ (669) de'i g.yas su dpal gtor nor gzugs ma dmar po sha dang bu ram sogs rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa zhig dang*/ 'bul gtor dang mchod pa spyi dang mthun par bsham/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun par byas la/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/ shū n+ya ta sa stong pa nyid du sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/ e las chos 'byung mthing ga'i dbus su/ padma dmar po dang*/ nyi ma/ bgegs kyi rgyal po kha bub tu bsgyel ba rnams brtsegs pa'i steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid mgon dmar dbang gi rgyal po'i skur gyur pa ni/ padma rā ga ltar dmar zhing zhal gcig phyag drug dang po gnyis gri thod bzung nas yum la 'khyud pa/ bar pa gnyis cang te'u rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ tha ma lcags kyu zhags pa bsnams// spyan gsum skra ser gyen du brdzes// thod skam lnga yi dbu rgyan dang*// rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can// stag lpags grol zhing g.yon brkyang stabs// mi rus sbrul dang g.yer khas brgyan// dur khrod chas brgyad sku la rdzogs// yum chen padma mkha' 'gro ma// chags pa'i nyams can sku mdog dmar// gcer mo phyag rgya lngas brgyan ma// gri gug thod bcas yab la 'khyud// gnyis ka'ang me dpung klong na bzhugs// gtso bo yab yum gyi mdun du ma hā ka la sku mdog nag po gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/

g.yas su kṣe tra pā la dmar po ḍā ma ru dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ rgyab tu dzi na mi tra nag po gri thod 'dzin pa/ g.yon du ṭākki rā dza ser po rtse gsum dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ phyi skor du dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba// gtso bo'i thugs kar rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ yum gyi thugs kar gri gug aṃ gis mtshan pa/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros/ shar lho dur khrod chen po bsil (670)ba'i tshal nas myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po mgon dmar dbang gi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ slar yang snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ arghaṃ

nas/ shabda 'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las yab yum gnyis ka la 'od dpag med dang*/ 'khor rnams la gtso bos dbu brgyan/ rang gi snying gar sngags kyi phreng ba bsgoms la/ oṃ badzra ma hā kā la kṣiṃ kṣe tra bighnān bi nā ya ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ ma gu ye swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzla'o// mdun bskyed bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las e las zhes pa nas/ gtso bos dbu brgyan gyi bar bdag bskyed dang 'dra ba las bdag nyid ces pa'i tshig bor ba ni khyad par ro/ /oṃ gu ru ma hā kā la sa pa ri wa ri bhyaḥ arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ nas/ shabda 'i bar gyis mchod/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med bde chen gsung*// rgyal ba kun gyi rang bzhin 'od dpag med// chos rje 'gro ba'i mgon mdzad spyan ras gzigs// dbang gi skur ston nag po che la bstod/ /mdun bskyed kyi bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ bzlas pa ci 'grub tu bya/ gtor ma byin rlabs nag po'i skabs dang 'dra/ snying po'i mthar i daṃ ba liṃ ta gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces phul/ gong bzhin mchod bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ sogs kyis 'dod don gsol ba btab/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar slob ma byin rlabs ji ltar byed pa thams cad rang gis kyang bdag 'jug gi tshul du dmigs pas blang bar bya'o// slob ma rnams kyi sngon 'gro'i bya ba yan chad nag po'i skabs dang 'dra ba las/ sems bskyed gsal gdab skabs/ mgon dmar dbang gi rgyal po'i (671)bka' zab mo zhes dang*/ gsan bya'i chos/ 'chi med rdo rje'i sku brnyes pa'i grub chen sgra gcan 'dzin sbas pa'i rdo rjes mkhas grub khyung po tshul khrims mgon po la stsal ba'i myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po zhi ba nor sgrub kyi skor las/
