mgon dmar dbang gi rgyal po 'di ni/ gsung rdo rje 'od dpag med kyi ngo bo byin rlabs shin tu myur zhing tshe dang dbang gi las sgrub pa la gzhan las myur zhing stobs che ba/ rtsa ba'i mgon po mthing ga nang ltar du sgrub pa yin cing zhag bdun tsam bsgrubs pas zhal ston par gsungs pa sogs yon tan tshad med pa dang ldan pa 'di nyid kyi rjes gnang sogs sbyar la/ gsol gdab nas rgyun bshags yan grub pa dang*/ khyed rang gi snying gar zla ba'i steng du/ rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa gsal btab la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta utpā da yā mi/ lan gsum/ gsang sngags 'byung ba dkon par bstan pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /res 'ga' 'byung ngam mi 'byung srid// u dumbā ra'i me tog ltar// brgya lam na ni res 'ga' 'byung*// gsang sngags spyod tshul 'byung ba ni// de bas kyang ni shin tu dkon// gnyis med zab mo'i spyod tshul 'dis// sems can sangs rgyas byed pa'o/ /zhes brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po'i rnam par spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs te gnyis su med par thim/ rol chen bya/ snying po'i mthar/ ā we sha ya a a a/ zhes lan bdun nas/ nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam bzla/ de'i rkyen gyis khyed rang rnams skad cig tsam gyis mgon dmar dbang gi rgyal po'i skur (672)gyur pa ni/ sku mdog dmar po/ gri thod ḍā ma ru rtse gsum lcags kyu zhags pa rnams 'dzin pa/ yum padma mkha' 'gro ma/ gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud par gyur/ lha ngo bstan pa ni/ 'di na myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa lags te/ chos 'byung mthing kha'i dbus su nas/ brtsegs pa'i steng du mgon dmar dbang gi rgyal po bzhugs pa ni padma rā ga ltar dmar ba

zhes pa nas/ tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba/ de thams cad kyang rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer med par mos mdzod/ dbang gi dngos gzhi ni/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med la mos gus dung pa byas pas/ de'i spyi bo'i oṃ dkar po las mgon po sku mdog dkar po/ sku chung la yan lag rags pa dpag tu med pa byung nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor thim pas bum pa'i dbang thob par gyur/ rol mo'i sgra bya/ yang mgrin pa'i āḥdamar po las mgon po sku mdog dmar po/ sku chung la yan lag rags pa dpag tu med pa chad nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par thim pas gsang dbang thob/ rol mo/ de bzhin du sbyar nas/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ sngon po las/ sngon po snying gar/ rol mo/ yang gnas gsum gyi yig 'bru gsum las dkar dmar mthing gsum/ gnas gsum kar du/ tshig dbang rin po che/ rol mo/ de rnams phyi'i dbang bzhi lags/ de nas yang bla ma mgon po dbyer med la mos gus dung pa byas pas/ mgon po yab yum rang gi spyi bor byon/ byang chub sems kyi ngo bo 'od zer du zhu/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs/ smin mtshams yan chad gang*/ bum dbang thob/ mgrin pa yan chad gang*/ gsang dbang thob/ lhen sna yan chad gang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ lus thams cad gang*/ tshig dbang rin po che bzhi pa thob (673)par mos mdzod/ de dag ni nang sku dngos kyi dbang bzhi'o// gtor ma mgon por gsal ba slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la// oṃ/ gzi brjid dpal 'bar mgon po yab yum sku// ngo mtshar lhun grub dam rdzas gtor ma 'dis// dam ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas// mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku la longs spyod shog /snying po'i mthar/ kā ya badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ des bum pa'i dbang bskur thob pa yin no/ /thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba mgrin par gtad/ āḥ/ zab mo gsang sngags mgon po yab yum gsung*/ bde chen snod bcud zag med bdud rtsi 'dis// dam ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas// 'gag med tshangs dbyangs gsung la longs spyod shog

/kā ya badzra gyi gnas su wā ka badzra= des gsang ba'i dbang bskur thob pa yin no/ /sindhū ra'i dkyil 'khor snying gar gtad la/ /hūm̐/ gzung 'dzin kun bral mgon po yab yum thugs// dri med snang stong me long ye shes 'dis// dam ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas// rnam dag ye shes thugs la longs spyod shog /tsitta badzra= des shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob pa yin no/ /'di skabs su yig rnying las ma bshad kyang*/ slob ma la nang mchod blud pa dang*/ snying gar sindhū ra'i thig le re mdzad pa phyag len la snang ngo*/ /de nas khyed rang rnams rig pa rten med gyi ngang du mnyam par zhog cig// ho/ chos dbyings mtha' bral spros pa rab zhi'i ngang*// rang rig ye shes ting 'dzin klong yangs 'dis// dam ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas// chos dbyings yang dag don la longs spyod shog /dzñā na badzra= des tshig dbang bzhi pa thob pa yin no// de dag ni gsang ba dam rdzas kyi dbang bzhi yin no// bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi thugs ka nas/ sngags kyi phreng ba'i tshogs rnams byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim par mos (674)la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ /snying po lan gsum/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// slar yang me tog rnams sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs la/ khyed rang rnams la gtor bas/ sngags nus pa mthu can du mos mdzod// bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /lan gsum/ de dag gi gnas skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig dang zhes sogs/ slob ma'i rjes kyi cho ga rnams ni/ mgon nag gi skabs su bshad pa kho nas 'grub bo// cho ga'i rjes chog kyang de dang mtshungs so// mgon dmar gyi sgrub thabs rtsa ba 'di yin cing*/ tshe sgrub ni 'di'i las kha char gyi lta yin par shes par bya'o// dbang bsdud kun las ches dga' ba// rmad byung sgrub thabs snying po 'di// yig rnying ma gtogs phyis byung gi

/lag len dkon phyir bris pa yin/ mgon dmar dbang gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ /na mo gu ru/ tshe dpag med dang spyan ras gzigs// myur mdzad mgon po zhes bya ba// de la btud nas sgrub thabs bshad/ 'dir mgon bka' lnga pa mgon ljang tshe bdag gi sgrub thabs ni/ stegs bu'i steng du chos 'byung ljang gu me ri can/ dbus su lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i tshom du bkod/ de'i steng du mañdzi la dpal gtor nor gzugs ma rgyan gyis brgyan la bzhag /g.yon du mañdzi'i steng du/ nang mchod ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba dang*/ de'i steng du sindhū ra'i dkyil 'khor mgon dmar gyi skabs dang 'dra bar bris la/ dar ljang gi gur phub/ g.yas su bum pa spyi dang mthun par bsham/ mchod gtor bsham tshul spyi dang 'dra/ mchod pa byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi rnam la bsgom/ swa bhā wa sa stong pas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su/ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i nang*/ gzhal med khang pho brang mtshan nyid thams cad thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus/ tsandan (675)gyi ljon pa'i drung du/ e las byung ba'i chos kyi 'byung gnas ljang gu/ de'i dbus su paṃ las padma'i lte bar nyi ma dang bgegs kyi rgyal po'i gdan la/ rang sems hūm̐ las gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag drug pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ bar pa gnyis kyis cang te'u dang tri shu la 'dzin pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis bgrang phreng dang zhags pa bsnams pa/ spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo'i dbu rgyan dang do shal/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang stag lpags dang dril bu g.yer kha'i phreng ba sogs rgyan thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/

pang du yum rdo rje ḍā ki ma sku mdog sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ thod skam lnga bcu'i do shal can gyis 'khyud pa/ gtso ba'i mdun du buddha ḍā ki dkar mo 'khor lo dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ lho ru ratna ḍā ki ser mo rin po che dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ nub tu padma ḍā ki dmar mo padma dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ byang du karma ḍā ki ljang khu ral gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang rus pa dang mi mgo'i phreng ba can sgeg cing chags pa'i nyams can/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o// de'i phyi rol du mkha' 'gro ma 'bum sde dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa 'khod par gyur/ thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ lte bar swā/ gsang gnas su hā/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po'i rnam par spyan drangs shing*/ khyad par shar lho dur khrod chen po (676)bsil ba'i tshal nas/ mgon po mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ kṣiṃ ring po nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod/ dbyangs dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung ste/ dpral mgrin thugs lte gsang gnas nas// oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā'i yig 'bru las// dkar dmar mthing ser ljang ba yi// 'od 'phros phyogs bcu kun khyab pas// rgyud drug sems can sdig sgrib sbyangs// skyabs gsum thugs rje'i mnga' bdag can// ye shes spyan drangs ma lus mchod// tshe bdag phrin las mgon por gyur// 'phro 'du 'od zer lngas bskul te// dbus 'gyur rang bzhin mchog sgrub nas// bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod du// dpal ldan 'byor bcu tshe yi bdag /phyag drug ye shes mgon po'i tshogs// dur khrod brgyad dang nyer bzhi yi// dam can 'khor bcas 'dir 'dus la// rnal 'byor bdag la mchog stsol cig /ces spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'am gnas lnga nas 'od zer 'phros// dbang gi lha rigs lnga mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ arghaṃ nas/ shabda 'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ oṃ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo yab yum la mi bskyod pa/ buddha ḍā ki la rnam snang*/ ratna ḍā ki la rin 'byung*/ padma ḍā ki la snang mtha'/ karma ḍā ki la don grub rnams kyis dbu brgyan/ gtor ma nag po'i mngon rtogs nas 'byung ba ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ ye shes kyi lha la dmigs te/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma drangs te gsol bar gyur/ snying po'i mthar/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan 'dun gyi gtor ma phul/ gu ru ma hā kā la bi shwa ḍā ka sa pa ri wa ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā nas/ shabda 'i bar gyis mchod pa 'bul/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med phrin las sku// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyis phyag mdzad pa// gang la gang 'dul de la der ston pa// phyag drug sna tshogs (677)mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal/ /ces bstod/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ badzra ma hā kā la ha ri ni sa sarba ā yur dzñā na siddhi dzaḥ ces ci 'grub bzla/ 'di la bdag mdun dmigs pas tha dad du sgom pa yin na'ang*/ bskyed chog phyogs gcig tu mdzad pa yin pas/ de nyid kyis bdag mdun gnyis char 'grub bo// bum pa'i nang du/ myur mdzad mkha' 'gro lnga dang bcas la skad cig gis grub bar gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags phreng 'od zer dang bcas pa 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ sngags kyi 'od zer rnams gzungs thag la 'khril zhing*/ bum pa'i nang gi bcud la thim/ mdun bskyed kyi gnas lnga nas 'od zer 'phros/

snod bcud thams cad kyi bkrag mdangs dwangs ma rnams bdud rtsi'i rnam pas bkug ste thim par gyur/ bum pa la dmigs nas snying po brgya tsam bzla'o// 'og tu slob ma la ji ltar byed pa'i cho ga rnams/ skabs 'dir dmigs pa'i sgo nas bdag 'jug gi tshul du blangs/ slob ma'i sngon 'gro'i bya ba/ phyag 'tshal khrus/ me tog bkye bsdu byas nas/ sems bskyed gsal gdab skabs/ mgon ljang tshe'i bdag po'i bka' zab mo/ zhes dang*/ dngos gzhi la/ gsan bya'i chos/ 'phags yul grub ba'i dbang phyug sgra gcan 'dzin sbas pa'i zhal snga nas/ mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor la nye brgyud du stsal ba myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po'i zhi ba nor du sgrub pa'i bye brag mgon ljang tshe'i bdag po'am phyag drug sna tshogs mkha' 'gro zhes grags pa 'di ni rgya gzhung las/ bar mtshams med par zhag bdun bsgrub// zhal mthong dngos grub rnam gnyis 'byung*// tshe 'phel gzhon nu'i lang tsho rgyas// lung bstan 'du ba rnam gsum 'byung*/ zhes bsngags par mdzad pa mgon po nyid thun mong ma yin pa'i tshul du sgrub pa/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub spyi dang khyad par tshe spel ba la mchog tu bsngags pa'i rjes gnang

sogs sbyar la maṇḍal 'bul/ gsol btab rnams mgon bka' spyi dang 'dra/ rgyas pa la dga' na/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed gnang ba sbyin pa/ rtog pa bsdu ba/ yan lag lnga pa/ rigs lnga'i sdom bzung rnams byas la/ bsdu na/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs (678) sogs gur nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa kho nas 'grub/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /ces sogs mgon dmar gyi skabs nas 'byung ba bzhin brjod/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed dbyer ma mchis pa'i dkyil 'khor gsal 'debs pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa nas/ 'khod par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin brjod/ de lha ngo bstan pa'i dod yin no// khyed rang rnams skad cig tsam gyis mgon ljang tshe bdag yab yum du gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ lte bar swā/ gsang bar hā/ slob dpon gyi gnas lnga nas 'od zer 'phros/ shar lho dur khrod chen po bsil pa'i tshal nas/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ 'ur 'ur/ chem chem byon pa khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim par mos mdzod/ /rol chen dang bcas pas snying po'i mthar/ a we sha ya āḥ.āḥ.āḥ zhes btags la drag tu bzla/ de ye shes dbab pa'i dod yin no// de nas dngos gzhi'i don du maṇḍal 'bul du bcug la/ bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med pas bdag la dbang bzhi bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol btab lan gsum rjes zlos byed du bcug /bum bskyed kyi lha'i dpral ba nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar po byung nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi phyi nang gi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bkrus par mos mdzod// bkra shis tshe brtan rnam rgyal bum bzang na// nyon mongs gti mug ye shes ngag pa'i lha// rgyal ba'i 'od gzugs sgrib bral longs sku bzhugs// phyag drug tshe dpag med mgon dbang bskur bas// me long ye shes 'phro 'du'i 'od zer can// mi shigs rdo rje'i sku yi dbang thob shog

/sngags bzla bzhin pas/ bum pa dpral bar reg ste/ bum chu blud/ de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la'ang rigs 'gres yang bum bskyed kyi mgrin pa nas/ bdud rtsi dmar po= nyon mongs 'dod chags dag pa'i ye shes lha/ rgyal ba'i chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong bzhugs// rtsa sngags stong nyid snying po'i dbang bskur bas// sor rtog= gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i dbang thob shog /mgrin par reg ste/ thugs ka nas bdud rtsi sngon po= nyon mongs zhe sdang dag pa'i ye= rgyal ba'i thugs mchog dpal gyi ye shes bzhugs// (679)mi 'gyur lhan cig skyes dga'i dbang bskur bas// chos dbyings= /rnam kun thams cad mkhyen pa'i dbang thob shog /snying gar/ lte ba nas bdud rtsi ser po= /nyon mongs nga rgyal dag pa'i ye shes lha// rgyal ba'i yon tan phan bde mchog stsol bzhugs// chos kyi dbyings dang rig pa dbyer med pa// mnyam nyid= /mthong thos dran reg myur du sangs rgyas shog /lte bar/ gsang ba nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun ljang gu= /nyon mongs phrag dog dag pa'i ye shes lha// rgyal ba'i phrin las rgyun mi 'chad par bzhugs// lnga ldan gsang rig gzungs sngags dbang bsgyur te// bya grub ye shes chen po'i dbang bskur bas// lhun grub rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing thob shog /snying po'i sngags bzla bzhin du/ gsang ba'i phyogs su reg pa ltar byas/ bum chu blud/ phyi ma rnams la bum chu 'thor bar mdzad pa'i phyag len yang snang ngo*/ /de dag ni bum pa'i dbang ngo*/ /sindhū ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi me long spyi bor gtugs/ thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba snying gar reg ste/ rgyal ba rab 'byams rgya mtsho dbyings brgyud pa'i// mtshan ldan thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba dang*// sgrib bral snang stong zung 'jug me long la// sindhūr chos 'byung mkha' 'gro'i gzhal yas nas// bde stong sa bon phyag mtshan rtsa sngags lhas// skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro/

/rtsa sngags brjod cing sindhū ras dpral bar thig le bya// nang mchod bdud rtsi sbyin no/ /de ni gsang ba'i dbang ngo*/ /de nas 'di skad ces brjod de/ gsang yum rdo rje mkha' 'gro las// lha mo spros te bu la gtad// snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde bas gang*// thabs dang shes rab dbyer med gyur// gang 'dul lha sku mtha' yas su// sems can don du byed gyur cig /rtsa sngags brjod la/ de'i don sgom du gzhug go // de ni shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo*// phyag rgya chen po'i don sgom du bcug ste/ (680)spros pa'i mtha' bral gcer mthong rang rig 'di// nam mkha' chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam sbyor ba/ skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas// ma rig 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgyud drug dang*// 'khrul rtog nyon mongs dug lnga rtsad chod nas// skyabs gsum kun 'dus go 'phang mchog thob shog// oṃ dha re dha re dha ra ṇa bha te swā hā/ zhes me tog gtor/ rgyas pa la spro na/ bkra shis bka' rgya ma brjod cing*/ mdor bsdu na/ nyin mo bde legs sogs shtso ka gcig brjod/ gtor ma'i bka' bsgo ba ni/ spyi bor bzung la/ gtor ma 'di nyid bla ma mgon po dbyer med du gsal ba'i mtha' bskor du sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor bar mos/ rang gi spyi bor byon/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi sku phra mo dpag tu med pa byung ste/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /dpal myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po ljang gu tshe'i bdag po sna tshogs mkha' 'gro 'khor mkha' 'gro ma bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas pa sogs mgon dkar ltar la/ thogs med du bsgrub pa dang*/ khyad par du tshe la gnod pa'i bar du gcod pa thams cad srung zhing zlog pa dang*/ 'chi ba med pa rdo rje tshe'i dngos grub stsal bar mdzad du gsol/ ces rol mo dang bcas te bka' bsgo bya/

de nas sngags kyi bzlas sung ni/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi thugs ka nas/ sngags kyi phreng ba'i tshogs byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim par mos la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ snying po lan gsum/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod// bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// slar yang me tog rnams sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs la/ khyed rang rnams la gtor bas/ sngags (681)nus pa mthu can du mos mdzod// bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ de dag gi gnas skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig dang zhes sogs/ slob ma'i rjes kyi cho ga dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi rjes kyi cho ga rnams ni mgon nag gi skabs su brjod zin pa ltar ro// kun nas zab mo'i tshe sgrub ste// bar chad bsrung thabs dga' ba'i tog /mgon ljang sgrub thabs snying po 'di// gzhan la phan phyir sbyar ba yin// mgon ljang tshe bdag gi sgrub thabs kyi le mtshan no// maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ rtsa brgyud bla ma rdo rje can// ye shes mgon po'i skur snang ba// zhabs kyi padmor phyag byas te// bla mgon dbyer med rjes gnang bshad// gnas dben par sa gzhir chag chag dang phyag dar legs par byas/ dkon mchog gi rten dang khyad par mgon po'i bris sku sogs legs par bsham/ sa gzhi dri bzang gis byugs par ji tsam 'tshams pa'i thig gru bzhi btab/ de gnyis kyi bar nag pos byas pa la dur khrod gcig bri/ de'i nang du zlum po gnyis skor/ zlum skor dang gru bzhi'i bar shar dkar lho ser nub dmar byang ljang ba byas la zlum skor gcig gi bar sngon po/ zlum po'i nang ljang khur byas pa'i dbus su chos 'byung mthing nag gru gsum me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su hūm̐ dam gri gug gi lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa bris/

de'i steng du mañdzi'i khar nas nag rjen btags las byas pa'i gtor ma dpal bshos zur gsum pa la mtha' mtheb kyus bskor ba rgyan dang bcas pa la mda' dar me long mgon po'i tsakli btags pa btsugs la bzhag /mtha' mchod pa dang gtor ma spyan gzigs sna tshogs pas bskor/ sngon gtor gnas yo byin rlabs/ yi dam bsgom bzlas sogs nas brtsams/ mdun bskyed sgrub tshul rtsa ba bar chad kun sel gyi skabs su bshad pa ji lta ba bzhin la/ khyad par gsol 'debs gong du/ mgon po'i dbu gtsug tu drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma sku mdog ser po nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas yid bzhin gyi nor bu thugs kar gtod cing*/ g.yon gser gyi dril bu dkur brten pa/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing (682)rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje 'chang nas brtsams te brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ bla ma'i sku las 'od 'phros/ mgon po 'od dang bde ba'i rang bzhin du 'ur 'ur sil sil gar mdzad/ mgon po las 'od 'phros/ bla ma'i sku la thim pas/ bla ma 'od dang bde ba'i rang bzhin du gyur/ dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra sil sil/ khrol khrol gar mdzad/ bla ma nyid mgon po/ mgon po nyid bla ma/ bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med par gyur/ bdag dang nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma mgon po dbyer med la gsol ba 'debs so// mgon po bla ma dbyer med la gsol ba 'debs so// drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so/ /zhes lan ci rigs dang*/ na mo buddha 'i gsol 'debs lan brgya rtsa las mi nyung ba dang*/ bla mgon dbyer med gsol 'debs tshig rkang lnga po'ang mang du brjod la/ gzhung bsnyen khyug tsam mthar/ gtor 'bul tshig lhug 'dod gsol ma sbyar ba dang*/ bstod pa yan grub pa dang*/ bdag 'jug blang*/ slob ma rnams khrus byas/ gser gyi maṇḍal bcas mdun du 'khod pa la/

slob dpon gyis/ 'o nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i ma gyur sems can thams cad kyi don du 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang ci nas kyang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bla ma mgon po dbyer med pa'i bka' zab mo zhu bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i thugs bskyed khyad par can gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/ de la rang cag rnams kyis snyed par dka' ba mi'i lus rten bzang po thob/ mjal bar dka' ba sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dang ni mjal/ bstan pa'i snying po gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam nyams su blang du yod pa'i dus 'dir/ snying thag pa nas chos la 'bad dgos/ chos bsgrub pa la deng sang snyigs ma'i dus 'dir mthun rkyen nyung zhing 'gal rkyen mang ba yin te/ (683)yum las/ rin chen chos kyang dkon la de la 'tshe ba mang*/ zhes gsungs pas/ de'i gnyen por chos skyong khyad par can re bsten dgos/ de la mnyam med shangs pa bka' brgyud pa 'di'i phyag bzhes dang bod kyi lha min 'dre min bsten pa'i lugs mi gcig /grub thob gtsang brgyud kyi srol skyong ba khyung po rnal 'byor gyi chos lugs yin/ khong gis mgon po phyag drug pa 'di rgya gar nas bod du spyan drangs pa yin te/ khyung pos rgya gar du byon nas/ bla ma me tri pa ko sa la bhi kṣa'i dur khrod nang zhugs pa la/ gser srang bdun phul nas/ nged bod rnams longs spyod chung ba yin pas/ nor sgrub mthu myur la rtags mtshan che ba gcig zhu zhus pas/ mai tri pa'i zhal nas/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu zhes kyang bya/ mgon po shing phung can zhes kyang bya/ tsandan gyi mgon po zhes kyang bya/ thugs rje chen po nag po zhes kyang bya/ ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug ces kyang bya ba/ tshe 'di dang bar do'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa/ lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du 'du ba/ mi nor rdzas gsum shugs la 'byung ba/ dgra thams cad brlag par byed pa/

zlog pas me tshugs pa/ mchog thun mong thams cad lo zlas 'grub pa/ mchog sgrub pas thun mong zhor la 'byung ba/ thun mong bsgrub pas mchog zhor la 'byung ba gcig yod pa de spyin gsungs so// de bla mas su la zhus byas pas/ kho bos dpal sha ba ri pa la thob/ dpal sha ba ri pa zhes bya ba de ni bram ze'i rigs su gyur pa/ dpal 'bras spungs dang nye bar grong khyer chen po sum cu rtsa gnyis yod pa'i dbus na/ tri pa la bya ba rol mo mkhas pa'i mchog tu gyur nas/ sngon sangs rgyas la glu dang rol mo'i mchod pas mnyes par byas pa de dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal gyi 'jag ma'i spyil bu gcig na bsgrub pa mdzad cing bzhugs yod (684)pa'i tshe/ nam mkha' la ḍā ma ru dang dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra chen po grags nas gzigs pa dang*/ ye shes kyi mgon po 'di byon nas rigs kyi bu nga'i sgrub thabs zungs shig gsungs nas/ sha ba ri pas sgrub thabs 'di yi ger bkod/ yang rje btsun rnal 'byor ma dang*/ thugs rje chen po dang sgrol ma gsum byon nas sgrub thabs kyi lung gsungs te bsngags par mdzad do// de lta bu'i bla ma de lho phyogs dpal gyi ri la bzhugs pa'i dus su kho bos phyag rgya chen po'i rgyud dang gdams ngag zhus/ de'i dus su phyag drug pa 'di gnang nas bsgrub pas zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig nas zhal mthong ba yin no// da khyung po rnal 'byor khyod kyis kyang*/ phyag drug pa 'di la nas nag rjen btags kyi gtor ma dang*/ spos sbyor ma chad par gyis/ khyi nag po la rdo ma rdeg /yid ches par gyis la bla ma dang dbyer med du ltos/ de ltar byas pas dngos grub thams cad tshul bzhin du ster bar 'gyur ro// zhes lung bstan nas bka' bsgo lan gsum gyi bar mdzad nas gnang ngo*// gzhan yang sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus su dur khrod chen po mun pa mi bzad pa zhes bya bar/ slob dpon chen po dha na saṃ skṛ ta zhes bya ba la/

ye shes kyi mgon po 'di zhal mngon sum du gzigs shing*/ 'khor tshogs dbang du bsdus nas las thams cad bsgrub par mdzad pa'i bla ma des/ rā hu la gupta badzra la zhal gzigs nye brgyud kyi tshul du gnang*/ des khyung po rnal 'byor 'phan yul jog po'i ri la bzhugs dus rgya gar nas nam langs pa la phebs te/ bod du nyi shar la gdams pa sgo skyel du mdzad pa ste/ grub thob rnam pa gnyis las brgyud pa'i myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po'i gdams skor la rjes gnang byin rlabs kyi bka' rigs mi gcig pa mang du bzhugs na'ang*/ zhi drag gi sgrub thabs kun gyi zab gnad srog snying (675)lta bu med du mi rung ba'i yan lag gi bka' gsum gyi dang po bla ma mgon po dbyer med 'di ni/ grub chen sha ba ri ba'i zhal nas/ sngags dang gsol 'debs phyed mar byas shing gtor ma phul na zhal myur du ston par 'gyur ro// de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas shing gsol ba btab na mos gus zhung zhung byed par bsam na gzhan don dpag tu med pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro// bla ma dang mgon po'i sku gang gsal ba la sems bzung na longs sku dang sprul skur 'tshang rgya'o// rtogs pa skyes tshad sdong po rtsa ba nas bcad pa bzhin du thag bcad na dag pa'i sa gsum thob bo// gsol ba btab pa'i rjes sam 'gro 'chag gang gi dus su yang cir snang thams cad gsal la 'dzin med glang po'i lta stangs su bzhag na chos skur 'tshang rgya'o// maṇḍal dang gtor ma bcas nas yid ches the tshom med par gsol ba btab na thun mong gi dngos grub ster bar byed do// ma yengs par zla ba bdun bsgom na de nyid du 'tshang rgya bar byed do// tho rengs thun re bskom na 'chi khar gzugs sku dang chos sku thob bo// dbang dang 'brel ba lan gcig thob na mtshams med pa lnga byas pa yang bar dor 'tshang mi rgya mi srid do// bla ma mgon po dbyer med la// bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi// bdag ni sems can thams cad kyi// nyon mongs ma lus bsal bar shog

/ces pa lan gcig thos pa dang gser la bris nas btags na yang 'chi khar zhal mthong bar 'gyur ro// ye shes mgon po mdun byon nas// bdag 'dra sha ba ri pa la// lan gsum bar du gsungs nas kyang*// bka' rgyas btab nas mkha' la gshegs// e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// tshig brgyud dag las ma spel cing*// ces ched du bsngags shing bka' rgyas btab pa'i gser chos (686)yin la/ spyir chos skyong gzhan dag la'ang bla mgon dbyer med kyi kha skad tsam re mchis kyang de dag ni chos skyong ye shes pa yin par sgrub pa dang bla ma nyid rtsa gsum kun 'dus su shes dgos pa'i gtan tshig tsam yin la/ 'di ni rgya gzhung gi khungs dang ldan pa'i sgrub tshul khyad par can byin rlabs kyi bka' dang bcas pa dmigs bsal du bzhugs pas 'di ltar sgrub pas nyams rtogs skyed byed kyi bla sgrub khyad par can du 'gyur ba ma zad/ mgon po 'di la rten bzhi gnad gsum zhes bya ba yod pas bla ma mgon po dbyer med du bsgrub pa 'di de kho na nyid kyi rten zhes bya ba mgon po 'di brten pa la med du mi rung ba'i yan lag kyang yin pas de lta bu'i bka' zab mo zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇḍal phul 'tshal/

zhes 'bul du gzhug /thal mo me tog dang bcas te gsol ba 'debs 'di'i rjes= khyod zhabs padmo spangs nas ni// gtso bo gzhan la skyabs ma mchis// 'gro ba'i dpa' bo thub chen pos// bdag la blo mchog stsal du gsol/ /lan gsum// de nas lha ngo sprad pa ni/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor pa de nyid srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang mi bzad pa'i dur khrod chen po'i dbus su sogs rtsa ba mgon mthing gi rjes gnang skabs ltar/ tshul bzhin du skong bar mdzad pa/ de dag gi steng du drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad sprin gtibs pa bzhin du bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba can gyi byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod// dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs lan gsum/ khyad par rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa mtha' dag legs par blangs nas tshul bzhin du bsrung bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun// ji tsam dus nas bzung nas su// ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// dus 'di nyid nas bzung nas su// nam zhig byang chub snying po la// yongs su gnas kyi bar dag tu// bdag gis byang chub mchog gi (687)sems// ma lus par ni bskyed par bgyi// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// deng nas brtsams te gzung bar bgyi// nam du yang ni mi spang ngo*// rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// padma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung*// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*// ma brgal ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/

/lan gsum/ de dag gis 'jug pa'i chos mdor bsdus pa grub nas/ dngos gzhi'i byin rlabs 'bebs pa'i slad du bla ma mgon po dbyer med pa la mos gus dung ba sogs mgon mthing gi skabs ltar la/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par sgoms (688)shig /de nas mdun bskyed gtor ma dang dbyer med pa'i mgon po'i spyi bor drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma sku mdog ser po sogs dbang sgrub skabs ltar la/ bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med pa'i bdag nyid du mos pa dung dung mdzad nas sku'i byin rlabs zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na mo buddha ya/ na mo gu ru ha/ badzra bī ra bī ri ṇe/ shrī ḍā ka ḍā ki nī/ dzo ga dzo gi nī/ sarba buddha bo dhi st+wā ya sha ra ṇāṃ/ gatstsha mi kyai/ zhes lan gsum/ bdag dang nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma mgon po dbyer med la gsol ba 'debs so// mgon po bla ma dbyer med la gsol ba 'debs so/ /zhes lan gsum brjod du gzhug /de ltar gsol ba btab pas/ mgon po'i spyi bo na bzhugs pa'i bla ma'i smin mtshams nas 'od zer dkar po dang mgon po'i smin mtshams nas mgon po'i sku dkar po chung la yan lag rags pa mang po byung*/ khyed rang gi smin mtshams na phar sib sib thim pas bla ma mgon po dbyer med pa'i sku'i byin rlabs thob snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la/ bla mas na mo buddha dang badzra ma hā kā la 'i sngags drag tu brjod cing rol mo'i sgra drag tu bya/ de la bla ma dang mgon po'i sku'i byin rlabs thob/ khyed rang gi lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag /bum pa'i dbang bskur thob snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /gsung gi byin rlabs zhu ba'i don du sngar ltar gsol ba gdab/ mgon po'i spyi bo na bzhugs pa'i bla ma'i mgrin pa nas 'od zer dmar po dang mgon po'i mgrin pa nas mgon po'i sku dmar po chung la rags pa mang po byung*/

khyed rang gi mgrin pa nas thar sib sib thim pas bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med pa'i gsung gi byin rlabs thob snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la sngags dang rol mo byed/ des bla ma (689)dang mgon po'i gsung gi byin rlabs thob/ khyed rang gi ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag /gsang ba'i dbang thob snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /thugs kyi byin rlabs zhu ba'i don du sngar ltar gsol ba btab/ mgon po'i spyi bo na bzhugs pa'i bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer sngon po dang mgon po'i thugs ka nas mgon po'i sku mthing ga chung la rags pa mang po byung*/ khyed rang gi snying kha nas phar sib sib thib pas bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med pa'i thugs kyi byin rlabs thob snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod// ces brjod la sngags dang rol mo byed/ des bla ma dang mgon po'i thugs kyi byin rlabs thob/ khyed rang gi yid kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dag /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med pa'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs zhu ba'i don tu gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod cig /bdag dang nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sogs gsol 'debs nyer gcig dang*/ na mo buddha lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas mgon po'i spyi bo na bzhugs pa'i bla ma'i sku'i cha thams cad las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa dpag tu med pa byung*/ mgon po'i sku'i cha thams cad las kyang mgon po'i sku chung la rags pa sna tshogs pa'i mdog can ḍā ma ru dang g.yer kha'i sgra dang hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa kyi sgra sgrogs pa dpag tu med pa byon te khyed rang gi lus kyi stod smad bar gsum nas phar sib sib thim pas khyed rang gi lus sems bde bas gang*/ lus kyi nang na mgon po rnams gar mdzad cing nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad zhal du gsol/

khyod kyi bar chad thams cad ngas sel/ mthun rkyen thams cad ngas sgrub ces pa'i gsung lhang lhang 'byon bzhin pa dang bcas pas (6890)khyed rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med pa'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs thob stim pa'i mos pa mdzod ces brjod la sngags dang rol mo dang bcas pas/ phyogs bcu dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i lha tshogs ye shes la sgrib pa mi mnga' ba/ thugs rje la phyi bshol mi mnga' ba/ mthu dang nus pa la thogs pa mi mnga' ba/ byin rlabs la rgyang ring thung mi mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis sku'i sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig /gsung gi sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig /thugs kyi sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig /sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mi zad pa'i sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig /da lta nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig /myur ba nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig /'dug sa 'di nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig /ces brjod do/ /des bla ma dang mgon po'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs thob/ khyed rang gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag /dbang bzhi pa thob snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /mtha' rten byin rlabs gtor ma'i dbang zhu ba'i slad du gsol 'debs 'di'i rjes zlos/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med sogs tshig rkang lnga po lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis gtor ma mgon por gsal ba de nyid khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor spyan drangs/

mos gus dung pa byas shing bla mas bka' bsgos (691)pa'i tshe/ sku'i gnas rnams nas bdud rtsi 'od zer gyi rnam pa dang khro chung me mtshon dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang gi lus la zhugs pas sdig sgrib nad gdon 'gal rkyen thams cad ba mo la nyi zer phog pa bzhin du bcom tshe bsod nyams rtogs la sogs pa 'phel zhing rgyas par byas/ bla ma mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i gsang ba gsum dang gnyis su med par byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /dpal ye shes kyi mgon po myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs dbang*/ rtsa brgyud bla ma/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ dam can rgya mtsho/ sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ ji ltar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i thugs bskyed dam tshig gnyen po ma g.yel bar rdo rje'i slob ma 'di la myur ba nyid du byin gyis rlob par mdzad du gsol/ mi 'bral bar rtag tu dgongs shing 'grogs la mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen dam pa mdzad du gsol/ byang chub sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar du gcod pa thams cad sel zhing dam pa'i chos dang mthun pa'i 'dod rgu'i dpal 'byor yar zla ltar 'phel ba sogs zhi rgyas dbang drag gi phrin las thogs med yid bzhin du 'grub bar mdzad du gsol/ mdor na thun mong dang mchog gi dngos grub ma lus pa myur ba nyid du bde blag tu thob par mdzad du gsol/ ces dang gtso 'khor gyi sngags rnams brjod/ mthar/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas steng gi nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams 'od du zhu nas gtor ma mgon por gsal ba la thim/ de las rang 'dra'i sku gnyis pa 'phros/ khyed rang la thim pas mgon po'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med par byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /spro na gtor ma'i cha shas sbyin par bshad/ bkra shis brjod/ de ltar dbang (692)dang 'brel pa lan cig thob na mtshams med pa lnga byas pa'ang bar dor 'tshang mi rgya mi srid par gsungs pa'i bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi bka' zab mo legs par grub

sogs kyis mtshams sbyar la/ dam tshig khas blangs nas de dang*/ dkyil 'khor rjes chog rtsa ba'i mgon po ltar ro// yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas ni// bla mgon dbyer med gsol 'debs yin// byin rlabs rgya mtshor 'jug nus na// don gnyis nor bu lon par nges// bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi rjes gnang gi le tshan no// maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ oṃ swa sti/ snying rje'i dbang phyug sems dpa' che// sdig sgrib 'joms phyir khros pa'i tshul// gang de'i zhabs kyi padmo la// btud nas grib sel rjes gnang bkod/ maṇḍal mchod gtor bsham tshul bar chad kun sel dang 'di/ sgrub thabs kyi phrin las kyang de dang mtshungs pa las/ spyan 'dren mchod bstod rjes/ mgon po'i dbu gtsug tu rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po phyag g.yas shel gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar gtod pa/ g.yon pas mnyam gzhag gi steng du thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba/ zhabs skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ steng gi nam mkha' la 'khod par gyur/ rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la grib kyis phog pa dang sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chag thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi gnas gsum nas yi ge brgya pa dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi tshogs 'phros/ bla ma'i gnas gsum du thim pas sku gsung thugs la grib kyis phog pa dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur/ yig brgya bdun/ des 'gre ste/ bla ma rin po che/ (693)mgon po'i sku gsung thugs la sogs dang*/ bla ma'i gnas gsum nas yi ge brgya pa sogs kyi mthar yig brgya bdun/

bla ma mgon po dbyer med/ 'khor rnams dang bdag gi sgo gsum la grib kyis phog pa dang sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma mgon po'i gnas gsum nas yi ge brgya pa dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi tshogs 'phros/ 'khor rnams dang bdag gi gnas gsum du thim pas/ 'khor rnams kyi sku gsung thugs la grib kyis phog pa dang sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chags thams cad dag /bdag gi lus kyi nang yi ge brgya pa'i 'od zer gyis gang bas sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag par gyur/ ces mos la yig brgya bdun te nyer gcig gam/ 'byung na re re la'ang grangs ci mang bzla/ mthar bshags pa dang gzhung bsnyen khyug tsam/ gtor 'bul bstod pa bdag 'jug bcas grub nas/ slob ma la khrus bya/ sems bskyed gsal gdab gong ltar la/ de'i ched du ye shes mgon po sdig sgrib sbyong mdzad kyi bka' zhes bsgyur/ de la 'dir myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po zhi drag gi sgrub thabs spyi la med du mi rung ba'i yan lag gi bka' gnyis pa grib sel mgon po 'di ni/ rgya gzhung las/ bla ma ye shes mgon po la// grib phog dam tshig 'gal gyur na// bshags pa bya zhing dam tshig bskang*// dam tshig bskang bas dngos grub thob// ces gsungs pa ste/ dper na rgyal rigs sam/ bram ze gtsang ma gdol pa'i gnas mi gtsang ba la 'byon tu mi gtub pa ltar rgyud ma dag pa'i sgrib pa can la bla ma mgon po'i thugs rje dang byin rlabs 'jug par mi 'gyur cing*/ khyad par rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig la 'gal nyams shor na dngos grub mi thob pa'i steng du bar chad sna (694)tshogs 'byung bar 'gyur la/ sgrib pa dag na byin rlabs rtsol med du 'jug pa dang*/ dam tshig nyams chags bskangs na dngos grub bde blag tu thob par 'gyur pa yin cing*/

de dag gi thabs ni gsar rnying kun las rdor sems kyi bsgom bzlas las zab pa gcig kyang ma gsungs shing de la'ang skabs don rigs pa yod pa las/ 'dir nyams chags sgrib pa sbyong ba la shin tu zab pa'i grib sel gyi bka' zab mo bsgrub par

sogs mtshams sbyar la maṇḍal/ gsol gdab/ lha ngo sprad pa/ rgyun bshags/ sdom bzung*/ slob ma lhar bskyed pa ni sngar ltar la/ de nas mdun bskyed gtor ma dang dbyer med pa'i mgon po'i spyi bor drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po phyag g.yas shel gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar bsnams pa/ phyag g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa mnyam gzhag gi steng na 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ sku las 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phro ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer gyi tshogs 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad sku rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad/ gsung rdo rje 'od dpag med/ thugs rdo rje mi bskyod pa'i rnam par spyan drangs te mdun gyi nam mkha'i khams thams cad sprin gyi phung po 'khrigs pa ltar bzhugs pa'i mos pa mdzad nas de rnams la mos gus drag po dang bcas te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis bdag gi rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams kyi sku gsung thugs la brten pa'i dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod du gzhug /de ltar gsol ba btab pas sku rdo rje rnams kyi thugs ka nas oṃ yig dkar po yig brgya 'od zer dkar po dang bcas pa byung ste/ gtor ma (695)dang dbyer med kyi mgon po'i spyi bo na bzhugs pa'i bla ma'i smin mtshams nas phar thim pas bla ma'i smin mtshams kyi nang thams cad oṃ yig dkar po yig brgya 'od zer dkar po dang bcas pas gang*/ bla ma'i sku'i dam tshig nyams chags thams cad dag go snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod la yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod par zhu/ zhes yig brgya bzlar gzhug /des bgre ste/ gsung rdo rje rnams kyi thugs ka nas āḥyig dmar po yig brgya 'od zer dmar po dang bcas pa byung

sogs gong ma ltar la/ bla ma'i mgrin pa'i nang thams cad gang*/ gsung gi dam tshig nyams chags thams cad dag snyam pa dang yig brgya lan gsum bzla/ thugs rdo rje rnams kyi thugs ka nas hūm̐ yig sngon po yig brgya 'od zer sngon po dang bcas pa byung*/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i nang thams cad gang*/ thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chags thams cad dag snyam pa dang yig brgya lan gsum bzla/ yang gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po'i sku gsung thugs la brten pa'i dam tshig nyams chags thams cad dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas bla ma'i spyi bo nas oṃ yig dkar po yig brgya 'od zer dkar po dang bcas pa byung nas gtor ma dang dbyer med pa'i mgon po'i smin mtshams nas phar thim pas mgon po'i smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu oṃ yig yig brgya 'od zer dang bcas pas gang mgon po'i sku'i dam tshig nyams chags thams cad dag snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la yig brgya lan gsum brjod du gzhug /de bzhin du bla ma'i mgrin pa nas āḥyig dmar po yig brgya 'od zer dmar po dang bcas pa byung*/ mgon po'i mgrin pa'i nang thams cad gang*/ gsung gi dam (696)tshig nyams chags thams cad dag snyam pa dang yig brgya lan gsum/ bla ma 'i thugs ka nas hūm̐ yig sngon po yig brgya 'od zer sngon po dang bcas pa byung*/ mgon po'i thugs ka'i nang thams cad gang*/ thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chags thams cad dag snyam pa dang yig brgya lan gsum/ yang gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis 'khor rnams kyi sku gsung thugs la brten pa'i dam tshig nyams chags thams cad dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/

mgon po'i spyi bo nas oṃ yig dkar po yig brgya 'od zer dkar po dang bcas pa byung nas/ gnod sbyin bzhi dang lha mo la sogs 'khor rnams kyi smin mtshams nas phar thim pas 'khor rnams kyi smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu oṃ yig yig brgya 'od zer dang bcas pas gang*/ sku'i dam tshig nyams chags thams cad dag snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la yig brgya lan gsum brjod du gzhug /de bzhin du mgon po'i mgrin pa nas āḥyig dmar po yig brgya 'od zer dmar po dang bcas pa byung*/ mgrin pa'i nang thams cad gang*/ gsung gi dam tshig nyams chags thams cad dag snyam pa dang yig brgya lan gsum/ mgon po'i thugs ka nas hūm̐ yig sngon po yig brgya 'od zer sngon po dang bcas pa byung*/ thugs ka'i nang thams cad gang*/ thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chags thams cad dag snyam pa dang yig brgya lan gsum bzla/ yang gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung phyi nang grib dang mi gtsang ba'i gnod pa thams (697)cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas gtor ma dang dbyer med pa'i mgon po'i spyi bo na bzhugs pa'i bla ma'i smin mtshams dang mgon po'i smin mtshams nas oṃ yig dkar po yig brgya 'od zer dkar po dang bcas pa byung khyed rang gi smin mtshams nas phar thim pas smin mtshams kyi nang thams cad oṃ yig dkar po yig brgya 'od zer dkar po dang bcas pas gang*/ bla ma dang mgon po gnyis kyi sku'i byin rlabs thob byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod la yig brgya lan gsum gyi rjes zlos mdzod cig ces yig brgya lan gsum zlar gzhug /bla mas kyang yig brgya brjod la rol mo bya/ des khyed rang gis tsho 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i lus kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chags thams cad dag

/bla ma dang mgon po'i sku dang dbyer med du 'gyur ba yin no// yang bla ma dang mgon po'i mgrin pa nas āḥyig dmar po yig brgya 'od zer dmar po dang bcas pa byung*/ khyed rang gi mgrin pa nas phar thim pas mgrin pa'i nang thams cad āḥyig yig brgya 'od zer dmar po dang bcas pas gang*/ bla ma dang mgon po'i gsung gi byin rlabs thob snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod pa yig brgya rol mo sogs byed/ des khyed rang gis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i ngag gi nad gdon sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chags thams cad dag bla ma dang mgon po'i gsung dang dbyer med du 'gyur ba yin no// yang bla ma dang mgon po'i thugs ka nas hūm̐ yig sngon po yig brgya 'od zer sngon po dang bcas pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga nas phar thim pas snying ga'i nang thams cad hūm̐ yig yig brgya 'od zer sngon po dang bcas pas gang*/ bla ma dang mgon po'i thugs kyi byin rlabs thob snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod cig (698) ces brjod la yig brgya rol mo sogs byed/ des khyed rang gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i yid kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chags thams cad dag /bla ma dang mgon po'i thugs dang dbyer med du 'gyur ba yin no// yang bla ma dang mgon po'i gnas gsum nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum yig brgya 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum dang bcas pa byung*/ khyed rang gi lus kyi stod smad thams cad nas thim pas lus kyi nang thams cad oṃ āḥhūm̐ yig brgya 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum dang bcas pas gang*/ bla ma mgon po'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs thob snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la yig brgya dang rol mo byed/ des khyed rang gi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dag

/bla ma mgon po'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams dang dbyer med du 'gyur ba yin pas de lta bu'i dga' spro dang nges shes bskyed par mdzod cig /ces brjod/ de nas gtor dbang*/ bkra shis rjes kyi rim pa rnams snga mas 'gre shes par bya'o// bsod nams blo gros ldan rnams kyis// bsgrub bya'i snying po 'di yin pas// mtha' yas 'jig rten rnams su yang*// brtson pa chen pos tshol bar rigs// grib sel mgon po'i rjes gnang gi le tshan no// maṅga laṃ// ༈ oṃ swa sti/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi rje// 'khor 'das dbang du mdzad de la// btud nas mkha' 'gro dbang sdud kyi// ngo mtshar gdams pa'i sgo 'byed bri// maṇḍal bca' gzhi sngar dang 'dra ba las/ rten gtor ma 'dzom na gsang rten dang ldan pa'i mda' dar me long dang lhan cig btsug /ma 'dzom na me long la sindhū ras hrīḥbacu gsum bris pa btags/ sgrub thabs phrin las rtsa ba bar chad kun sel ltar la/ bzlas pa'i gong du/ mgon po'i dbu gtsug gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid/ sku mdog dmar po g.yas thod pa'i ḍā ma ru 'khrol zhing*/ (699)g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ bzod par dka' ba'i gzi brjid can/ sgeg cing lang tsho la bab pa/ chags pa'i nyams can/ spyan gzigs pa tsam gyis mkha' 'gro dang srid gsum dbang du sdud pa/ skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mgon po'i dpral ba'i sindhū ra'i thig le gru gsum gyi steng na yi ge hrīḥdamar po 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi ngo bo bcu gsum yongs su gyur pa las/ gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo lang tsho ma/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas cang te'u/ g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs pa'i gar stabs can/ spyan gsum nam mkha' la hrig hrig gzigs shing gar mdzad pa bcu gsum sgrol ma'i ngo bo/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad bdag gi dbang du bsdus/

dgos 'dod thams cad char bzhin du babs par gyur/ oṃ badzra na ra kriṃ kriṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ ces pa brgya rtsa sogs ci 'grub bzla/ de nas gzhung gi bzlas pa/ gtor 'bul/ bstod pa/ bdag 'jug bcas grub pa dang*/ slob ma la khrus bya/ sems bskyed gsal gdab skabs/ de'i ched du ye shes mgon po mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud pa'i bka' zhes bsgyur/ de la 'dir myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po zhi dag gi sgrub thabs spyi la shin tu gal gnad che ba yan lag gi bka' gsum pa mkha' 'gro dbang sdud 'di ni/ rgya gzhung rdo rje'i gsung las// bla ma mgon po sin dhū ra'i// sngags rnams dbang gi mdog ldan pas// mgon po dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams// dbang du sdud pa'i gnad mchog 'dis// 'di dang phyi ma'i don mchog 'grub// gcig brgyud 'di ni srog ltar chongs// zhes gsungs te/ ye shes mgon po 'di nyid kyi sprul pa'i rang gzugs dur (700)khrod bsil ba'i tshal na rtag tu bzhugs shing dur khrod brgyad dang yul chen nyer bzhi'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi tshogs kyi gtso bo mdzad cing dbang bsgyur ba yin pas rnal 'byor zab mo 'di la brten nas gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang ye shes las dang 'jig rten gyi chos skyong ba thams cad gnad la dbab cing dbang du 'dus pas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad lo zla tsam gyis 'grub pa dang*/ phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med bsam pa tsam gyis sgrub pa'i gnad chig brgyud thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams ngag srog ltar gces pa yin pas de lta bu'i byin rlabs kyi bka' zab mo bsgrub pa sogs kyis mtshams sbyar nas maṇḍal gsol gdab sogs nas/ slob ma lhar bskyed yan gong dang mtshungs/ de nas mdun bskyed gtor ma dang dbyer med pa'i mgon po'i dbu gtsug gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs dang*/

bcu gsum sgrol ma'i ngo bor gsal thob la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod// bla ma rin po che gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad dbang du 'du bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas mgon po'i spyi bo na bzhugs pa'i bla ma'i sku las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu dpag med 'phros/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad la phog pas de thams cad 'od zer 'bar ba'i rang bzhin can gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ bla ma mgon po mkha' 'gro ma dang bcas pa la thim pas bla ma 'od dang bde ba'i rang bzhin du 'bar/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams dmar sgor sgor gar mdzad/ mgon po yang ḍā ma ru dang dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra 'ur 'ur sil sil 'khrol ba'i sku las mkha' 'gro ma dpag tu med pa byung*/ slob ma mgon por gsal ba'i lus thams cad dang khyad par (701)dpral ba'i sindhū ra'i steng du stong gsum g.yo bar byed pa'i mkha' 'gro ma bcu gsum du gyur cing de rnams kyi sku las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu phyogs bcur 'phros pas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dgos 'dod thams cad bsdus nas byin gyis brlab byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ byas la ḍā dril dang bcas pas na ra kriṃ kriṃ brjod/ des mkha' 'gro dbang sdud kyi byin rlabs grub nas mgon po gnad la 'bebs par byed pa la gsol 'debs 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma rin po che bdag la mgon po 'khor bcas gnad la dbab pa'i byin rlabs mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas/ mgon po'i spyi bo na bzhugs pa'i bla ma'i sku las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad shin tu khros pa'i rnam par spyan drangs bla ma la thim pas/ bla ma de nyid sku mdog smug nag 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba'i rnam pa can shin tu khros pa'i rang bzhin gyis mgon po'i spyi bor chem chem 'ur 'ur gar mdzad cing 'od zer smug nag 'phros pas/

mgon po 'khor bcas dang khyad par mgon po'i sku la dmar lam lam phog pas mgon po 'khor bcas gnad la phab ste mgon po dgra bgegs kyi steng du mer mer sil sil gar mdzad cing khros 'khrugs zhabs sa la brdab/ zhal nas hūm̐ phaṭa kyi sgra drag po sgrog spyan gsum 'khor rnams la hrig hrig gzigs pas 'khor rnams kyang rang dbang med par drag tu khros shing dam pa'i chos bsgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i gnod byed bstan dgra sdig can rnams kyi snying kha nas lcags kyus bkug /mgrin pa zhags (702)pas bcings/ yan lag lcags sgrog gi bsdams nas bsad bcad gtub/ don snying gtso bo la stob sha rus lhag med du 'khor rnams kyis rol/ gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad thal ba rdul phran bzhin du brlag pa'i sgo nas byin gyis brlab pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ sha chen spos sbyor sogs bsregs shing rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas/ oṃ badzra ma hā kā la kṣiṃ kṣe tra bighnān bi na ya ka trag raglo rakṣa ru dhi ra tsitta la a dun rbad hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badzra ma hā kā la kṣiṃ kṣe tra bighnān tsitta la a dun dun bi bi nā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces srog sngags brjod do/ /des mgon po nyid gnad la dbab pa'i byin rlabs grub nas de dag gi mtha' brten du sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs rjes su gnang ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ gtor ma ye shes mgon por gsal ba'i spyi bo'i oṃ las 'od zer dkar po byung*/ slob ma'i spyi bo'i oṃ la phog pas oṃ yig dngas gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin du gyur te/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung*/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas lus kyi sgrib pa dag /mgon po'i sku'i byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod

byas la rol mo dang spos btul/ yang gtor ma ye shes mgon por gsal ba'i mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od zer dmar po byung*/ slob ma'i mgrin pa'i āḥl phog pas āḥyig dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin tu gyur te/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas ngag gi sgrib pa dag /mgon po'i gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs par mos mdzod/ spos rol bya/ yang gtor ma ye shes mgon por gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po byung*/ slob ma'i snying ga'i hūm̐ la phog pas hūm̐ yig dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin tu gyur te/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas yid kyi sgrib pa dag /mgon po'i thugs kyi (703)byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spos rol bya/ de nas mgon po'i gnas gsum gyi oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūm̐ mthing gsum rbad kyis chad nas khyed rang gi gnas gsum gyi yig 'bru gsum la rim gyis thim/ oṃ dang āḥyang hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu 'a chung la thim/ 'a chung ha yig la/ ha mgo bo la/ de zla tshes la/ de thig le la/ thig le nā da la/ de'ang je phra je phrar gyur te stong nyid du yal/ 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i rang ngo la mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ zhes cung zad mnyam par bzhag /de nas gtor dbang sogs rdzas kyi cho ga snga ma ltar bya'o// chos 'di yon tan tshad med pas// rgya mtsho'i gos can kun tu khyab// gzhan las byin rlabs sgo myur bas// dngos grub 'dod rnams bsten par 'os// mkha' 'gro dbang sdud gnad dbab lhan cig pa'i rjes gnang gi le tshan no// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ 'od dpag med mgon thugs rje'i sku// drag po'i tshul ston he ru kar// btud nas gsang sgrub mchin kha yi// byin rlabs bka' yig 'di ltar ro// maṇḍal chos 'byung mthing nag gru gsum me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su padma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar hūm̐ mchin pa bri/

rten gtor mchod gtor bca' gzhi sogs bar chad kun sel dang 'dra/ sgrub tshul bdag bskyed sogs de dang khyad par med pa las/ mdun bskyed bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du chos 'byung gru gsum yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i dbus su paṃ las padma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du gam̐ las tshogs bdag dkar po glang po che'i gdong pa can/ g.yas pas sa'i snying po lo ma dang bcas pa zhal du gsol zhing g.yon rin po che sna tshogs skyugs pa'i ne'u le 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum pa/ rin po che dang rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa gan rkyal du bsgyel ba'i steng du hūm̐ dmar smug las gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar (704)bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po skye 'gro'i re ba tshul bzhin du skong ba/ sku mdog mchin kha nag la dmar ba'i mdangs can/ zhal gcig phyag drug pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'dril ba/ rab tu bzhad pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dang*/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ dpral bar sin dhū ra'i thig les byugs pa/ spyi bor mi bskyod rgyal pos rgyas btab pa/ phyag g.yas dang pos rdo rje gri gug dang*/ g.yon dang pos thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ g.yas bar pas thod skam gyi phreng ba/ tha mas ḍā ma ru drag tu 'khrol ba/ g.yon gnyis pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ tha ma na rdo rje zhags pa bsnams pa/ zhabs gnyis srid gsum rnam par gnon pa'i shugs can mnyam pa'i stabs krig krig zhabs kyis bgegs kyi rgyal po mnan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs la/ dar ljang gu'i ske rags bcings pa/ sbrul sngon pos dbu skra bcings shing*/ dmar po'i snyan cha/ khra bo'i dpung rgyan/ dkar po'i mgul rgyan/ ser po'i lag gdub/ ljang gu'i do shal/ dkar po'i rkang gdub dang ska rags can/

phyag zhabs thams cad la dril bu g.yer kha'i phreng ba dang ldan pa/ sbom thung yan lag hrag pa/ gzi brjid mtha' yas pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan rin po che'i rtse bran can dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis mdzes pa/ 'jigs pa'i nga ro 'brug ltar sgrogs pas bdud dang bgegs thams cad brlag par mdzad pa/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ (705)de'i g.yon du rakta'i rgya mtsho chen po dmar la dwangs pa'i nang du dre'u rkyang ser gwa pa'i steng du bhyoḥlas ma gcig 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma sku mdog char sprin ltar gnag pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas dang pos ral gri/ gnyis pas gri gug /g.yon dang pos nal bu'i rgyal mtshan/ gnyis pas skra dang bcas pa'i thod rlon khrag gis gang ba bsnams pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra kham nag gyen du 'bar ba'i gseb na rma bya'i mdongs dang zla tshes kyis brgyan pa/ snyan g.yas la seng ge dang g.yon na sbrul nag 'phyo ba/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ mi lpags kyi stod g.yogs dang re lde ser po'i shams thabs la sbrul gyi ska rags bcings pa/ lte ba'i dbus na nyi ma 'char ba/ dre'u'i steng na phyed skyil gyis bzhugs pa'i zhal phyi la gzigs pa/ de'i mdun tu chu srin gdong can dang rgyab tu seng ge'i gdong can/ phyi rol tu ma mo'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'o// yab yum gnyis kyi mdun du hūm̐ las gnod sbyin kṣe tra pā la smug nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug phyar zhing dgra srog gcod pa/ g.yon bandha khrag gis gang ba gtso bo'i zhal du stob pa/ dom nag smyon pa la chibs pa'o// g.yas su tri ljang gu las dzi na mi tra sku mdog ljang nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas ḍā ma ru 'khrol zhing g.yon sdigs mdzub nam mkha' la gdengs pa stag la chibs pa'o// rgyab tu dzaḥlas gshin rje ṭā kki rā dza sku mdog smug nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rgyu ma'i zhags pa g.yon sdigs mdzub nam mkha' la gdengs pa spyang ki la zhon pa'o// lha mo'i g.yon tu hūm̐ las bdud mgon trag shad nag po zhal gcig phyag bzhi g.yas dang pos thod khrag gnyis (706)pas ru mtshon dmar po phyar ba/

g.yon dang pos lcags kyi tho lum dang gnyis pas tsandan gyi bing chen bsnams pa/ za 'og sngo khra'i ber dang sag lh+wam nag khra gsol zhing rta nag rting dkar la chibs pa'o// de thams cad kyang rngams shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ sma ra smin ma dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ spyan gsum dmar zlum g.yo bas dgra bgegs la gzir ba/ mi mgo skam rlon gyi phreng ba 'phyang ba'o// de dag gi phyi rol du shar du brgya byin sogs rtsa ba'i phrin las dkyus ltar btang ba las/ gsol 'debs dang yig brgya ma 'grub kyang chog /gong gsal gnang dbab skabs kyi dmigs bzlas de sbyar/ dngos gzhi'i bzlas pa'ang shā sa na gtso bor byed/ gtor 'bul bstod pa bdag 'jug grub nas/ slob ma la khrus dang*/ sems bskyed gsal gdab skabs/ de'i ched du myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po gsang sgrub mchin kha'i bka' zhes bsgyur/ de la 'dir sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas nyid rdo rje'i chos skyong ba'i skur bzhengs te rdo rje 'chang gi mgon po zhes grags pa mchog thun mong gnyis ka lo zla tsam gyis 'grub par byed pa 'di la/ phyi sgrub 'jig rten dbang phyug /nang sgrub khro bo rta mgrin/ gsang sgrub ye shes mgon po ltar sgrub pa'i skor rgyud dang grub thob so so'i gdams ngag gi bka' srol mtha' yas pa bzhugs pa rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa/ sgrub brgyud kyi shing rta chen po dpal shangs pa bka' brgyud la bka' babs pa'i bka' srol 'di la'ang sgrub thabs mi gcig pa du ma bzhugs pa las da lam gsang sgrub mchin kha'i rjes gnang bsgrub pa la sogs mtshams sbyar nas maṇḍal dang*/ gsol gdab lha ngo bstan pa sngar bzhin song nas/ sprin gtibs pa bzhin tu bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar bdag gzhan nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs )707)su 'gro zhing thun mong gi sdom pa gzung bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/

phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o// chos la= dge 'dun la= bla ma yi dam gyi lha tshogs la= ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa la skyabs su mchi'o// bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum/ slob ma lhar bskyed tshul gong gis 'gre zhing gnas gsum 'bru gsum bcas gsal gdab/ de nas khyad par gyi gsol 'debs 'di'i rjes zlos/ bla ma rin po che bdag la dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i sku'i rjes su gnang ba mdzad du gsol/ sku'i byin rlabs lus la 'jug par mdzad du gsol/ bum pa'i dbang bskur du gsol/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ gtor ma mgon por gsal ba'i thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te de'i spyi bo'i oṃ yig las kyang 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs thams cad dang*/ khyad par du yang mgon po'i sku'i byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs oṃ yig la thim/ de las bdud rtsi mchin kha'i rgyun babs/ slob ma'i smin mtshams nas zhugs/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo khrig mer gyis gang bas lus kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sangs kyis dag /bum pa'i dbang thob/ ye shes mgon po'i sku'i byin rlabs thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ byas la ḍā dril dang bcas pas sngags brjod/ yang gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ bla ma rin po che bdag la dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i gsung gi rjes su gnang ba mdzad du gsol/ gsung gi byin rlabs ngag la 'jug par mdzad du gsol/ gsang ba'i dbang bskur du gsol/ de (708)ltar gsol ba btab pas bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ gtor ma mgon por gsal ba'i thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te de'i mgrin pa'i āḥlas kyang 'od zer 'phros/

phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad dang*/ khyad par du yang mgon po'i gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs āḥl thim/ de las bdud rtsi mchin kha'i rgyun babs/ slob ma'i mgrin pa nas zhugs mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo khrig mer gyis gang bas ngag gi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sangs kyis dag /gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ye shes mgon po'i gsung gi byin rlabs thob pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la ḍā dril dang sngags brjod/ yang gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ bla ma rin po che bdag la dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba mdzad du gsol/ thugs kyi byin rlabs yid la 'jug par mdzad du gsol/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur du gsol/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ gtor ma mgon por gsal ba'i thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te de'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las kyang 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad dang*/ khyad par du yang mgon po'i thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs hūm̐ la thim pas/ de las bdud rtsi mchin kha'i rgyun babs/ slob ma'i snying ga nas zhugs/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo khrig mer gyis gang bas yid kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sangs kyis dag /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ ye shes mgon po'i thugs kyi byin rlabs thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ (709) byas la ḍā dril dang bcas pas sngags brjod/ yang gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ bla ma rin po che bdag la dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i rjes su gnang ba mdzad du gsol/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum la 'jug par mdzad du gsol/

dbang bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che bskur du gsol/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ gtor ma mgon por gsal ba'i thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te/ de'i gnas gsum gyi yig 'bru gsum las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ mgon po'i gnas gsum gyi yi ge gsum la thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar du gang bas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad skad cig nyid la sangs kyis dag /tshig dbang rin po che thob/ ye shes mgon po'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs thob pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la sngags brjod/ de nas sngags dbang zhu ba'i phyir du me tog 'thor bzhin du 'di'i rjes zlos/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi// bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sngags phreng las sngags phreng gnyis pa thon/ slob ma'i zhal du zhugs/ snying gar nyi gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ yig gi mthar g.yas bskor du 'khod par mos la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod byas la/ snying po dang*/ rtsa sngags shā sa na lan gsum/ slob dpon gyis me (710) tog spyi bor bzhag ste/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ de nas gtor dbang dang rjes kyi bya ba rnams gong dang mtshungs so// rgya che rab zab blo gros can// khyung po'i gdams ngag mtha' yas las// gang 'di yid bzhin nor mtshungs pa'i// bsam kun lhun gyis grub byed do// gsang sgrub mchin kha'i rjes gnang gyi le tshan no// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ byin rlabs mgon po snying gi dbus// mi shigs thig ler bkod nas 'dir// 'phags yul grub pa kun gyi gtso// mda' bsnun chen po'i bka' srol 'chad// maṇḍal gtor ma'i bca' gzhi sogs rjes gnang bar chad kun sel gyi skabs dang 'dra zhing*/

slob dpon gyis gnas yo nang mchod byin rlabs bdag bskyed sogs sngar dang 'dra/ mdun gyi maṇḍal gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du rdo rje'i brag sna tshogs pa'i mdog can gyi steng du/ paṃ las sna tshogs padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gaṃ las tshogs kyi bdag po/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa'i tshogs thams cad mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang nad gdon thams cad sbyangs/ 'od zer tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal drag po ye shes kyi mgon po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod khrag steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis thod pa'i phreng ba dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis kyis kha ṭwāṃ ga dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ zhal dbus mthing g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba/ rab tu khros pa'i zhal gsum gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum phyogs bcur sdang mig tu blta ba/ khro gnyer shin tu bsdus pa/ sma ra smin ma dmar ser glog ltar 'khyug cing dbu (711)skra kham ser gyen du brjes pa/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu la brgyan cing khrag 'dzag pa'i mgo bo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ snyan rgyan mgul rgyan gdu bu ska rags sogs rin po che dang rus pa dang dril bu g.yer kha dang bcas pa/ sbrul sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs glang po che'i pags pa'i stod g.yogs can/ yan lag rags la bzod par dka' ba'i gzi brjid can/ dpral bar sin dhū ra'i g.yung drung 'khyil pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyangs pa/ sku las skyes pa'i ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de'i phyogs bzhir padma dang nyi ma dgra bgegs kyi steng du mdun tu dzā las dzā li ma nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/

g.yas su kṣe las kṣe tra pā la ma du ba'i mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas ḍā ma ru dang g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ rgyab tu ma las ma hā kā li ma dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ g.yon du ṭā las ṭā kki rā dza ma ser mo g.yas rtse gsum dang g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa/ bzhi ka'ang shin tu khros shing spyan gsum ma/ sma ra dang smin ma dang dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes pa/ rus pa la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ sku las skyes pa'i me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de dag gi phyi rol du bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dpag tu med pa rnams kyis bskor bar gyur pa'i gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po'i 'od zer gyis po ta la dang bsil ba'i tshal la sogs pa'i gnas nas mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ (712)oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra e hya hi khriṃ khriṃ

zhes sogs kyis spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes brjod pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur bas lus gang dri ma dag bde ba chen po myong*/ chu'i lhag ma spyi bor gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ 'khor rnams la ye shes mgon pos dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ shrī badzra ma hā kā lā ya sa pa ri wā ra ārghaṃ pra tī tstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ pā dyaṃ nas shabda 'i bar dang*/ snying po la 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod 'bul/ bstod pa ni/ khyod sku zhal gsum phyag drug 'jigs pa'i gzugs// khyod gsung hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi nga ro sgrogs// khyod thugs mi bzad snying rje rab 'bar bas// phyi nang bar chad kun 'dul khyod la bstod// phyogs bzhi'i lha mo bzhi po khyed rnams kyis// dpal ldan he ru ka yi bka' bzhin du// zhi rgyas dbang drag la sogs las rnams ni// g.yel ba med par da lta bsgrub par mdzod// gzhan yang mgon po'i bka' nyan 'khor bcas kyis// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs pa// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod tshogs 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag gis bcol pa'i las kun mdzod/ /ces bstod/ bzlas pa'i skabs su/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ mgon po gtso 'khor gyi thugs rgyud bskul te las rab 'byams bsgrub par bsam ste/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la swa sthi shaṭha na ma ma hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces snying po dang*/ badzra ma hā kā la kṣiṃ kṣe tra sogs nye snying dang shā sa na bzla/ (713) 'khor rnams kyi sngags bzla bar spro na/ oṃ ma hā kā li hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kā li kṣe tra pā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rā dza ṭa kki rā dza hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ ma hā kā li ni sha trūṃ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzlas/ slar mchod bstod bya zhing bdag nyid 'jug /slob ma la khrus bya/ sems bskyed gsal gdab skabs/ de'i ched du myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang zhes bsgyur/ de'ang sngon dge bsnyen chen po zhi ba'i go cha lcags kyi byin pa can du grags pa de ri po ta lar lan gsum byon/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dngos su mjal/ snga phyir pho brang gzhal med khang gzhan thams cad mjal zhing bskor/ rten kun la'ang phyag mchod grub pa la/ mtha' gcig na khang bzang shin tu che ba nam yang sgo mi 'byed pa zhig 'dug pas/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams la sgo 'di 'byed bar zhu zhus pas/ 'di sgo phyes na 'jig rten gsum po mtha' dag dngangs shing 'chi ba'am 'chi la thug par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pas/ slar 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs nyid la zhus shing gsol ba btab pas sprul pa'i pho nya zhig mngags te 'phags pa'i bkas gnang ba'i stobs kyis sems can su la'ang gnod pa med par sgo phyes/ der ye shes mgon po 'di nyid mjal/ gsol ba btab pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ 'dzam bu'i gling du sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa skyong ba la 'byon par zhu zhes gsol ba btab pas zhal gyis bzhes pa ltar/ dur khrod chen po bsil ba tshal gyi shing n+ya gro dha'i phug na sprul pa'i sku zhig rtag tu bzhugs/ de la brten nas dpal sa ra ha sogs kyis sgrub thabs mdzad par grags/ gzhan yang ye shes kyi sku gcig dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten na bzhugs pa las slob dpon klu (714)sgrub dang bram ze mchog sred kyis gdan drangs pa'ang bshad/ de dag la brten nas 'phags pa'i yul du gdams ngag gi bka' srol ci rigs pa byung zhing*/ bod du'ang gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyis mgon rkyang gi skor bsgyur ba dang*/ steng ba lo tsā bas mkha' 'gro drug bskor gyi gdams pa bsgyur ba dang*/

mgar chos bzang gis sa ra ha dang sha ba ri'i gzhung sogs bsgyur ba las/ khyad par du 'phags pa mkhas grub khyung po'i bka' grol las byon pa'i myur mdzad ye shes mgon po'i chos skor las/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha'i lugs kyi mgon po zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang sogs mtshams sbyar la maṇḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// phrin las dbang phyug ye shes sku// dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang stsol/ zhes lan gsum/ de nas lha ngo bstan pa/ thun mong thun min gyi sdom pa bzung ba/ slob ma ltar bskyed bcas bla mgon dbyer med skabs su smos pa ltar/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par sgoms shig ces pa'i bar song nas/ de nas dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang zhu ba'i phyir du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod// bla ma ye shes mgon po yis// dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur du gsol// sgrib bzhi dag par mdzad du gsol// phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub pa dang*// sku bzhi thob par mdzad du gsol// de ltar gsol ba btab pas rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ shar lho bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod tsandan gyi shing rkang gcig pa'i drung na bzhugs pa'i mgon po 'khor bcas kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te sku'i cha thams cad las mgon po 'khor bcas kyi sku che chung dpag tu med pa byung*/ (715)gtor ma mgon por gsal ba'i dpral ba nas kyang mgon po 'khor bcas kyi sku che chung dpag tu med pa/ sku rngam brjid dang ldan pa/ gsung hūm̐ phaṭa dang ha ha'i sgra drag po sgrog cing rigs kyi bu khyed rnams kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad ngas sel mthun rkyen thams cad ngas bsgrub/ zhes gsung lhang lhang byon bzhin pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ba rnams slob ma'i dpral ba nas zhugs/

lus kyi nang thams cad khrig mer gyis khengs/ lus kyi nad gdon bar du gcod pa thams cad dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag gi rnam par zhal du dmar chem chem gsol nas tshar bcad pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ ḍā dril dang spos dud bcas te snying po dang nye snying brjod pa 'og ma rnams la'ang 'gre/ des mgon po 'khor bcas kyi sku'i byin rlabs lus la zhugs/ lus kyi sdig sgrib bar du gcod pa thams cad dag /bum pa'i dbang thob/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus dang mgon po'i sku dbyer med du gyur snyam pa mdzod cig /slar yang bla ma yi dam dbyer med pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sogs sngar ltar la/ gtor ma mgon por gsal ba'i mgrin pa/ zhes dang*/ slob ma'i mgrin pa nas/ ngag gi nad gdon/ gsung gi byin rlabs ngag la/ ngag gi sdig sgrib/ gsang ba'i dbang*/ ngag dang mgon po'i gsung dbyer med/ ces bsgyur/ slar yang bla ma yi dam sogs sngar ltar/ gtor ma mgon por gsal ba'i thugs ka// slob ma'i snying kha nas/ yid kyi nad gdon/ thugs kyi byin rlabs sems la/ yid kyi sdig sgrib/ shes rab ye shes kyi/ yid dang mgon po'i thugs dbyer med ces bsgyur/ slar yang bla ma yi dam sogs sngar ltar las/ gtor ma mgon por gsal ba'i gnas (716)lnga/ slob ma'i gnas lngar/ sgo gsum cha snyoms kyi nad gdon/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs yongs su rdzogs pa sgo gsum la gcig char du zhugs/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ khyed rang rnams kyi sgo gsum dang mgon po'i sku gsung thugs dbyer med ces bsgyur/ de nas sngags kyi bzlas lung zhu ba'i phyir du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi// bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas mgon po'i thugs kar nyi gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags phreng kha dog nag po 'od zer me 'od 'phro bas bskor ba de las sngags phreng mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du mgon po'i zhal nas thon/

khyed rang rnam pa'i zhal du zhugs/ snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ gi mthar g.yas bskor du 'khor/ de las drag po'i 'od zer me 'od rab tu 'bar ba 'phros pas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bya sgro me la bsregs pa bzhin du gzhob thul thul bsregs shing tshar bcad pa'i mos pa byas nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod byas la gtso 'khor thams cad kyi sngags lan gsum rjes zlos byed du bcug /slob ma'i mgor me tog bzhag la/ bcom ldan 'di la sbyin lags kyis// 'di la nye bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ de nas byin rlabs yongs rdzogs gtor mas bka' bsgo ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ gtor ma 'di nyid myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po sogs bar chad kun sel gyi skabs ltar las/ bla ma brgyud pa'i skabs/ rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha/ dpal ldan sha ba ri dbang phyug sogs nas/ chos rje sangs rgyas ston pa nas/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du byon pa'i (717)dpal ldan bla ma dam pa de rnams kyi zhes bsgyur// rjes kyi bya ba rnams kyang de dang mtshungs so// 'phags yul grub brnyes kun las kyang*// yon tan khyad 'phags bram ze'i lugs// mkha' 'gro bzhi skor grags pa 'di// sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i snying po lags// bram ze chen po sa ra ha'i lugs kyi mgon po zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang gi le tshan no// maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ sangs rgyas kun gyi bstan srung zhing*// sangs rgyas kun dang dbyer med pa// myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs dbang la// btud nas rgyan can bka' yig bri// maṇḍal chos 'byung mthing nag me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su hūm̐ dang a bri/ de'i dbus su rten gtor mdun du mchod gtor rnams sngar ltar la/ g.yas su bum pa bdud rtsi dang dri bzang chus bkang ba/ kha rgyan mgul chings dang bcas pa/

g.yon tu thod pa'i bdud rtsi rnams bsham/ byin rlabs rnams dang bdag bskyed sngon tu 'gro bas/ mdun gyi maṇḍal bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/ e las chos 'byung mthing nag me rab tu 'bar pa'i nang du sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma dang tshogs kyi bdag po'i steng du/ hūm̐ las gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan pa dang a las rdo rje as mtshan pa gnyis las 'od zer 'phros don gnyis byas 'dus pa las dpal ye shes kyi mgon po sku mdog shin tu gnag pa zhal gcig phyag drug pa/ phyag drug gi g.yas g.yon gyi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod khrag thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis thod pa'i phreng ba dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis kha ṭāṃ ga dang rdo rje'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum dmar po sdang mig tu blta ba/ khro gnyer bsdus shing smin ma dang sma ra dbu skra nag po rnams gyen du brdzes pa/ thod skam lngas dbu la brgyan cing thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ dpral bar sindhū ras byugs pa/ sbrul dkar (718)khras dbu skra bcings shing dmar khras snyan rgyan byas pa/ ser pos mgul rgyan ljang gus phyag gdub dang do shal byas pa/ nag khras zhabs gdub dang ska rags byas pa/ rus pa'i rgyan dril bu g.yer kha dang bcas pas spras pa/ stag gi pags pa'i shams thabs dang glang po che'i pags pas stod g.yogs byas pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis sku las skyes pa'i me'i phung po'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje gcig shes ma sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yon gyis thod khrag yab la stob cing g.yas pas gri gug bzung nas yab la 'khyud pa/ thod skam lngas dbu rgyan dang thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa'o// phyogs bzhir mdun tu padma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du dzā las dzā li ma nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/
