g.yas su padma dang nyi ma'i steng du kṣe las kṣe tra pā la ma du ba'i mdog can g.yas ḍā ma ru dang g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ rgyab tu padma dang nyi ma'i steng du ma las ma hā kā li ma dmar nag g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ g.yon du padma dang nyi ma'i steng du ṭā las ṭā kki rā dza ma ser mo g.yas rtse gsum dang g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa/ de thams cad kyang zhal gcig spyan gsum ma mche ba gtsigs pa/ smin ma dang sma ra 'khyugs cing dbu skra gyen du g.yengs pa rus pas brgyan cing drag po'i gzugs can no// de'i phyi rol du bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor bar gyur pa'i gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis bsil ba'i tshal la sogs pa nas mgon po 'khor dang (719)bcas pa skad cig gis spyan drangs/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra e hye hi khriṃ khriṃ zhes sogs brjod nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes brjod pas de rnams kyis oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur bas lus gang chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil pa las gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ 'khor rnams la gtso bos dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sogs sngags tsam gyis mchod/ nang mchod 'bul/ chos dbyings ngang las sogs kyis bstod/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la snying po dang*/ yum la/ oṃ a swā hā/ zhes bzla/ gtor 'bul dang mchod bstod mdor bsdus bya/ bum pa bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du e las chos 'byung

zhes pa nas bzlas pa'i bar sngar ltar bya/ bzlas pa'i skabs su rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros bum nang gi lha rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs bum pa gang bar bsam la gong gi sngags gnyis po bzla/ mchod bstod gong ltar bya/ mgon po gtso 'khor zhu ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsir gyur par bsam la bdag 'jug blang*/ de nas slob ma khrus bya/ sems bskyed gsal gdab skabs/ de'i ched du ye shes mgon po rgyan can gsang sgrub kyi bka' zab mo zhes bsgyur/ de la spyir sems can thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che gnas shing rgyas pa gal che/ bstan pa srung ba la chos skyong khyad par can zhig nges par dgos pa yin cing de la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs bskyed kyi dbang gis ye shes mgon po 'di las lhag pa nam du'ang med pas/ (720)sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhugs pa thams cad kyis chos skyong 'di la gtor ma re phul zhing bstan pa srung ba'i gnyer bcol na bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa dang*/ rang gzhan gyi bar chad sel zhing bsam pa thams cad 'grub par gsungs pa dang*/ khyad par ye shes mkha' 'gro ni gu'i gdams ngag 'chad pa dang*/ nyan pa dang*/ nyams su len pa rnams la mgon po 'di nyid ma bsgrubs kyang shugs la 'go zhing phrin las sgrub par mdzad pa yin la/ 'di nyid kyi gdams pa mkhas grub khyung po'i bka' srol mtha' yas pa zhig bzhugs pa las/ skabs 'dir gsang sgrub rgyan can du grags pa'i bka' zab mo bsgrub pa la

sogs kyis mtshams sbyar nas maṇḍal 'bul du gzhug // gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ na mo buddha ya/ na mo dharma ya/ na mo saṃ gha ya/ kun mkhyen ye shes snying po can// srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong ba// de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gter// gtso bos bdag la bka' drin stsol/ /lan gsum/ lha ngo bstan pa dang thun mong dang thun mong min pa'i sdom pa bzung*/ slob ma lhar bskyed/ gnas gsum byin rlabs par bla mgon dbyer med ltar bya/ de nas slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ gtor ma mgon por gsal ba la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag med 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs thams cad mgon po gtso 'khor gyi sku che chung dpag tu med pa'i rnam pa spyan drangs/ slob ma'i spyi bo nas thim pas lus thams cad lha sku 'od zer dang bcas pas gang ba la brten nas lus gyi sdig sgrib bar chad thams cad sbyangs/ mgon po'i sku'i byin rlabs thob pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la rtsa sngags (721) brjod cing spos rol bya ba 'gre/ des sku'i rjes gnang grub pa lags/ yang bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ gtor ma mgon por gsal ba la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag med 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad mgon po gtso 'khor gyi sku che chung dpag tu med pa'i rnam pa spyan drangs/ slob ma'i mgrin pa nas thim pas lus thams cad lha sku 'od zer dang bcas pas gang ba la brten nas ngag gi sdig sgrib bar chad thams cad sbyang*/ mgon po'i gsung gi byin rlabs thob pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la rtsa sngags brjod cing spos rol bya/ des gsung gi rjes gnang grub pa lags/ yang bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/

gtor ma mgon por gsal ba la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad mgon po gtso 'khor gyi sku che chung dpag tu med pa'i rnam pa spyan drangs/ slob ma'i snying kha nas thim pas lus thams cad lha sku 'od zer dang bcas pas gang ba la brten nas yid kyi sdig sgrib bar chad thams cad sbyang*/ mgon po'i thugs kyi byin rlabs thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ /byas la rtsa sngags brjod cing spos rol bya/ des thugs kyi rjes gnang grub pa lags/ de nas dbang bzhi zhu ba'i don tu gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod// bla ma ye shes mgon po yi// dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur du gsol// sgrib bzhi dag par mdzad du gsol// phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub pa dang*// sku bzhi thob par mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ de la bum dbang gi slang (722)du nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyis bdud rtsi'i chus gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa gyis shig /bum pa mgor bzhag la/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa mi zhes brjod la bum chu sbyin/ de ltar bum pa'i dbang bskur bas lus kyi sgrib pa dag /bum pa'i dbang thob/ lha sku bsgom pa la dbang*/ sprul pa'i sku 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag pa yin no// de nas gsang dbang gi don tu dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yab yum spyan drangs/ mdun bskyed kyi mgon po'i zhal du zhugs/ chags pa chen po'i mes zhu/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi padmar byon nas bde ba skyes shing*/

de lta bu'i bde ba'i rten byang sems de nyid khyed rang rnam pa'i ljags thog tu bzhag nas gsang dbang bskur byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la nang mchod dam thod pa'i bdud rtsi sbyin la/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad kyi// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa'i// rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu hya a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ de lta bu'i byang sems myong ba la brten nas bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams skyes/ de'i rang ngo la mnyam par bzhag pas gsal stong dbyer mi phyed pa'i ye shes mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar gsang ba'i dbang bskur bas ngag gi sgrib pa dag /gsang ba'i dbang thob/ sngags bzla ba la dbang*/ longs sku 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag pa yin no// de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi slad du dmigs pa (723)'di bzhin tu mdzod/ gtor ma ye shes mgon po yab yum dngos su gsal ba'i yum las rang 'dra ba'i yum gnyis pa spros pa khyed rang mgon por gsal ba dang snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yab yum spyan drangs/ slob ma'i lus la zhugs/ chags pa chen po'i mes zhu ba'i dga' bzhi rim bzhin drangs/ rdo rje nor bu'i rtser lhan skyes kyi dgar ba brten nas bde ba chen po mtha' dbus med pa skyes/ de'i rang ngo la mnyam par bzhag pas bde stong zung 'jug gi ye shes mngon tu byas par mos mdzod// gsang gsum ye shes mkha' 'gro las// mkha' 'gro spros nas bu la gtad// snyoms par zhugs pas bde bas gang*// lhan skyes ye shes chen po thob// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pra dzñā dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ de ltar dbang gsum pa bskur ba la brten nas yid kyi sgrib pa dag /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ dngos dang yid kyi rig ma bsten pa la dbang*/ chos sku 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag pa yin no// dbang bzhi pa'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/

khyed rang ye shes mgon po gtso 'khor skad cig gis gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros snod bcud thams cad la phog pas snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang bcud thams cad ye shes mgon por gyur/ de rnams 'od kyi rnam par bkug ste 'khor rnams la thim/ 'khor rnams gtso bo la thim/ slob ma mgon por gsal ba yang sku'i stod smad nas 'od du zhu nas thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig la thim/ de yang zhabs kyu nas rim bzhin je phra je phrar gyur nas dbyings su yal te 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang du mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ zhes brjod la dar cig mnyam par 'jog tu bcug la/ nam mkha' skye med mtshon pa'i phyir// (724)nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med// nam mkha' mnyam pa nyid sbyor bas// rang sems stong pa chos kyi sku// tshig gi ngo bor bstan par bya// chos thams cad spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba de dbang bzhi pa'i ngo bo yin no/ /zhes ngo sprad/ de ltar tshig dbang rin po che bskur bas sgo gsum cha snyoms kyi sgrib pa dag /dbang bzhi pa thob/ lam zung 'jug sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku thob pa'i nus pa bzhag pa yin no/ /zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ de nas sngags kyi bzlas lung dang*/ gtor dbang*/ rjes kyi bya ba rnams bya ste bar chad kun sel du bshad pa bzhin no// sngon sbyangs blo gros dag pa'i mkhar// chos zab zla ba'i gzugs brnyan 'char// des kyang skye dgu mtha' yas pa'i// yid ci gdung ba sel bar byed// gsang sgrub rgyan can du grags pa'i rjes gnang gi le tshan no// maṅga laṃ// ༈ oṃ swa sti/ spyan ras gzigs dbang rnal 'byor ma// sgrol ma myur mdzad mgon po dang*// dbyer med bla ma rdo rje 'chang*// spyi bor bkod nas rjes gnang 'bri// maṇḍal padma 'dab bzhi pa'i lte bar nyi zla'i gdan la tshom bu sngon po/ shar kyi pad 'dab la nyi gdan tshom bu nag po/ lho'i pad 'dab la dmar po/

nub tu dkar po/ byang du ljang gu ste tshom bu lnga bkod/ mthar mchod gtor kyis bskor ro// de nas skyabs sems spyi ltar byas la/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ phyi rol du me ri 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo rdo rje'i ra ba dang gur rnams su gyur/ de'i nang du bdag nyid yi dam gyi skur gsal ba'i spyi bor chos 'byung phyi dkar la nang dmar ba bde ba 'char zhing rgyas pa 'od kyi rang bzhin can gyi dbus su padma 'dab ma bzhi pa lte ba khru gang gis mtho ba la nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan la hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum rdo rje (725)dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan cing*/ dar gyi na bzas klubs pa zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa 'od zer 'phro ba'o// mdun gyi pad 'dab la nyi ma'i gdan la/ hūm̐ las gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las dpal ye shes kyi mgon po sku mdog char sprin ltar gnag pa/ zhal gcig phyag drug pa/ zhabs gnyis bzhengs pa'i stabs su bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos gri gug /bar pas thod pa'i phreng ba/ tha mas ḍā ma ru drag tu 'khrol ba/ g.yon gyi dang pos thod khrag /bar pas rtse gsum/ tha mas rdo rje'i zhags pa bsnams pa/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ zhal bgrad cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ smin ma dang sma ra ag tshom brjid pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan pa/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs la dar ljang gu'i ske rags bcings pa/ lto ba 'phyang zhing yan lag rnams sbom la rags pa/ dpral bar sin dhū ras byugs shing*/

phyag dang zhabs rnams dril bu g.yer khas brgyan pa/ glang po che'i lpags pa rlon pa gos su gyon pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na tshogs bdag dkar po gan rkyal du 'gyel ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o// g.yas kyi pad 'dab la nyi ma'i gdan la hrīḥlas gri gug hrīḥs mtshan pa las rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ lo bcu drug lon pa'i rnam pa can/ zhal 'dzum zhing mche ba nas tsam 'bur ba/ spyan gsum g.yon phyogs su gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug thur du brkyangs nas (726)'dzin pa/ g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba steng phyogs su bzung nas zhal du gsol ba/ mchan khung g.yon na kha ṭāṃ ga bsnams pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing*/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan mnan pa'o// rgyab kyi pad 'dab la zla ba'i gdan la hrīḥlas padma hrīḥs mtshan pa las spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pa'i bum pa dang*/ g.yon padma dkar po'i yu ba thugs kar 'dzin cing snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba/ dbu skra dpung pa'i steng na nag si le yod pa 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs shing g.yon bskum pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o// g.yon gyi pad 'dab kyi zla gdan la tāṃ las utpal tāṃ gis mtshan pa las rje btsun sgrol ma sku mdog ljang gu/ lang tsho dar la bab cing*/ lo bcu drug lon pa'i rnam pa can/ phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin dang*/ g.yon utpala'i yu ba 'dzin pa/ spyi bor don yod grub pas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs shing g.yon bskum pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o// de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong ma lus pa rdo rje 'chang dang lha bzhi'i rnam par spyan drangs/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ gnyis su med par thim/ skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur/ bla ma lha bzhi'i tshogs la phyi me tog bdug spos/ nang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ gsang ba snyoms 'jug gi bde ba/ de kho na nyid bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes la sogs pa mchod pa'i khyad par bsam gyis mi khyab pas mchod cing mnyes par bgyi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ na (727)mo buddhā ya/ na mo gu ru he/ badzra bī ra bī re ci/ shrī ḍā ka ḍā ki ni/ dzo ka dzo ki nī/ sarba buddhā bo dhi sa twā ya/ shar ṇa gatstsha mi kyai/ lan gsum/ bla ma'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib dag /bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thob par gyur/ de bzhin du lha so so la dmigs te rim bzhin sngags brjod pa ni/ oṃ badzra ma hā kā la kṣiṃ kṣe tra bighnān bi nā ya ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum/ mgon po'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs sogs nas/ mgon po'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thob par gyur/ ces rigs 'gre/ oṃ badzra na ra kriṃ kriṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum/ rnal 'byor ma'i sku las= oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ oṃ badzra rakṣa na maḥs manta hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum/ spyan ras gzigs kyi sku las/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re swā hā/ lan gsum/ sgrol ma'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib dag /sgrol ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thob par gyur/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ lha bzhi spyan drangs bla ma'i spyi bor spyan ras gzigs/ mgrin par sgrol ma/ thugs kar mgon po/ lte bar rnal 'byor ma rnams bzhugs par gyur/ sngags tshan lnga sbrel nas lan gsum bzla/ rang gi gsang gnas nas rlung g.yos/ lte bar rnal 'byor ma rnams bzhugs par gyur/

sngags tshan lnga sbrel nas lan gsum bzla/ rang gi gsang gnas rlung g.yos/ lte bar gtum mo ye shes kyi me sbar/ bla ma'i sku la phog pas bde ba chen pos lha bzhi bdud rtsir zhu nas sku lus gang*/ gsang ba'i lam nas rang gi spyi bor zhugs/ mgrin pa yan chad gang*/ lus kyi sdig sgrib dag /bum pa'i dbang thob/ sku'i byin rlabs (728)zhugs/ snying ga yan chad gang*/ ngag gi sdig sgrib dag /gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ lte ba yan chad gang*/ yid kyi sdig sgrib dag /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ lus thams cad gang*/ sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag /dbang bzhi pa thob/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ bla ma 'od du zhu/ rang la thim pas/ rang lus 'od du yal/ sems ma bcos pa la mnyam par bzhag go /de nas maṇḍal bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las padma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte ba khru gang gis mtho ba la nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan la hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang zhes pa nas/ skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur/ ces pa'i bar gong bzhin brjod/ mchod pa byin rlabs byas la/ gu ru de ba tsa tu ra sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis phyi mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐

gis nang mchod/ gsang mchod dang de kho na nyid kyis mchod pa yid kyis bya/ gang gi drin gyis sogs shtso ka gcig dang*/ byin rlabs ma lus 'byung ba'i sgo// dngos grub ma lus thob pa'i gnas// bar chad ma lus sel ba'i lha// bla ma lha bzhi'i tshogs la 'dud/ ces bstod/ gtor ma yod na yi dam spyi ltar byin brlabs/ lha rnams kyi ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus bdud rtsi'i bcud drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ gu ru badzra dha ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi/ lan gsum/ mgon po sogs la so so'i rang sngags mthar gtor sngags btags pa lan gsum gsum gyis phul/ mchod bstod dang*/ mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs kyis phrin las zhu/ de nas slob ma khrus bya/ sems bskyed gsal gdab skabs/ de'i ched du bla ma dang lha bzhi dril sgrub kyi bka' zab mo zhes bsgyur/ de'ang grub thob chen po sha ba ri pas bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod du sgrub pa la bzhugs pa'i skabs su thog mar dpal (729)ye shes kyi mgon po nyid byon nas rang gi sgrub thabs la sogs pa gsungs/ de nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ spyan ras gzigs/ sgrol ma rnams kyang byon nas rang rang gi sgrub thabs gsungs/ byin rlabs lha bzhi 'bral ba med/ ces bya ba yin pas lha bzhi po 'di ngo bo dang phrin las gnyis ka'i sgo nas gcig bsgrubs pas kun 'grub par 'gyur ba'i phyir nam yang tha dad yod pa ma yin kyang*/ rnam pa tsam du'ang bzhi po phyogs gcig tu dril ba'i sgrub thabs kyang mdzad nas mai tri pa la gnang*/ lho phyogs kyi grub chen rā hu la yang yum la 'khrungs ma thag lha bzhi zhal gzigs/ phyis rdo rje mkha' spyod mas sgrub thabs rnams gnang ba ste/ mkhas grub khyung pos bla ma dam pa de gnyis dang*/ khyad par ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro su kha siddhi las gsan pa yin cing*/ ji skad du/ ma yengs zla ba gsum nas 'grub// tho rengs thun re ma chags bsgom// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub 'grub// ces gsungs te/

de lta bu'i byin gyis brlab pa'i lha bzhi'i bka' 'bul bar byed pa la/ slob dpon gyi bya ba sngon du grub zin/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon tu maṇḍal phul mdzod/ /ces brda sprad/ de nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug par 'tshal/ /lan gsum/ mdun bskyed bla ma lha bzhi'i lha tshogs (730)rnams kyi spyan sngar rgyun bshags dang sdom pa bzung ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod// dkon mchog gsum la sogs gsum/ de nas slob dpon bla ma lha bzhi'i ngo bor bzhugs pa la mos gus drag po dung pa gcig byas pa'i rkyen gyis thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed bla ma lha bzhi'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang gi lus la phog pa tsam gyis ma dag pa'i snang zhen sbyangs te/ lus 'khor lo bde mchog gi skur gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar khyed rang rnams yi dam gyi skur gsal ba'i spyi bor chos 'byung phyi dkar la nang dmar ba zhes pa nas/ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa rnams su gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces gong bzhin bskyed chog gi tshig brjod nas lha rnams dam tshig ba'i tshul du bskyed la/ de nas mdun bskyed maṇḍal gyi dbus na bzhugs pa'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang la mos gus drag pos gsol ba btab pa'i rkyen gyis de nyid yer gyis byon khyed rang gi spyi bo'i rdo rje 'chang la thim/ sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/

khyed rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib dag /bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spos dang ḍā dril bya zhing*/ na mo buddhā ya 'i gsol 'debs tshar gsum brjod/ yang mdun bskyed kyi mgon po la gsol ba btab pas/ de nyid yer gyis byon/ khyed rang gi spyi bo'i mgon po la thim/ sku las rang 'dra dpag tu med pa chad/ khyed rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad zhal du dmar chem chem gsol/ mgon po'i sku gsung thugs dang sgo gsum dbyer med du 'dres pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spos dang ḍā dril mgon po'i sngags lan gsum gyis byin rlabs 'bebs pa 'gre'o/ /(731)yang rnal 'byor ma la gsol ba btab pas/ de nyid yer gyis byon/ khyed rang gi spyi bo'i rnal 'byor ma la thim/ gsang gnas nas bdud rtsi dmar po'i rgyun babs/ khyed rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib dag /rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spos rol sngags tshar gsum/ yang thugs rje chen po la gsol ba btab pas/ de nyid yer gyis byon/ khyed rang gi spyi bo'i spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la thim/ bum pa dang sku las bdud rtsi dkar po'i rgyun babs/ khyed rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib dag /thugs rje chen po'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags brjod cing spos ḍā dril/ yang sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas/ de nyid yer gyis byon/ khyed rang gi spyi bo'i 'phags ma sgrol ma la thim/ zhabs g.yas pa'i mthe bong las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ khyed rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib dag /sgrol ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags dang spos ḍā dril bya/

de nas dngos gzhi zhu ba'i yon tu maṇḍal= gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ byang chub rdo rje sogs gsum/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhugs pa'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis 'khor gyi lha bzhi spyan drangs te bla ma'i spyi bor spyan ras gzigs/ mgrin par sgrol ma/ thugs kar mgon po/ lte bar rnal 'byor ma rnams bzhugs pa la mos gus dang bcas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod// na mo buddhā ya sogs nas/ tu re swā hā 'i bar/ sngags tshan lnga sprel ba lan gsum/ de nas khyed rang (732)gi rkang 'og gi rlung g.yos/ lte ba'i gtum mo ye shes kyi me sbar pa'i 'od zer bla ma'i sku la phog /lha bzhi 'od du zhu/ sku lus kyi cha thams cad nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ khyed rang gi spyi bor zhugs/ mgrin pa yan chad gang*/ lus kyi sdig sgrib dag /bum pa'i dbang thob/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ḍā dril/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis snying ga yan chad gang*/ ngag gi sdig sgrib dag /gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ḍā dril/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis lte ba yan chad gang*/ yid kyi sdig sgrib dag /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ḍā dril/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis lus thams cad gang*/ sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag /dbang bzhi pa thob/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs zhugs/ mthar bla ma 'od du zhu nas/ khyed rang la thim pas sgo gsum rdo rje gsum dang dbyer med du gyur par mos la sems 'dzin med du ci gnas mnyam par zhog mdzod/ ḍā dril bag tsam re bya ba ma gtogs gzhan mi dgos/ des byin rlabs lha bzhi'i bka' grub pa yin pas 'di nyid yi dam du bzung zhing dam tshig las mi 'da' bar bgyid do snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/

gtso bos ji ltar sogs dbang rjes spyi ltar bya/ lha bstims zin pas/ yig brgyas bzod gsol dang*/ shis brjod tsam las rjes chog gzhan mi dgos so// yon tan bsngags pa mtha' yas pa'i// dril sgrub 'di ni spros med kyi// rnal 'byor can rnams snying gi dpyid// gdams ngag rgya mtsho'i snying po'ang yin/ lha bzhi dril sgrub kyi rjes su gnang ba'i bka' bshad pa'i le tshan no// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ bdud 'joms phrin las thogs med pa// khrag 'thung (733) chen pos de ring 'dir// snying po'i bstan pa rgyas pa dang*// las kun 'grub pa'i shis pa stsol// gang zhig spros pa la dga' zhing lag len rgyas par bya ba dag gis/ mgon po'i bka' chen bcu gsum rdzogs pa'i mthar brtul zhugs kyi rjes gnang byed pa'i srol snang zhing*/ de'ang skyi shod pa'i yig char mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu rjes su bzhag pas de'i rjes gnang gi mthar sel bar snang yang*/ 'dir gong gi gsang sgrub rgyan can la sbrel na 'jug pa bde bas de ltar na gtor dbang grub ma thag par/ 'di'i byin rlabs nas 'jug cing slob ma lhar bskyed spyan 'dren mi dgos/ 'on kyang rtsa ba mgon mthing gi bka' tsam rdzogs pa la'ang 'di'i rjes gnang sbyor du rung ba kho na yin cing*/ dkar dmar sogs la sbrel na/ dkyus su bshad pa'i slob ma lhar bskyed dgos pa ni khyad par ro// de'ang rjes gnang gang dang sbrel ba de'i gsham dang mnyam du/ gri gug sogs phyag mtshan drug so so ba/ dbu rgyan thod phreng sbrul rgyan glang lpags stag lpags rus pa'i rgyan drug sindhū ra rnams sta gon byas la/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa yongs su gyur pa las ngo bo dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi bdag nyid yin pa la rnam pa phyag mtshan dang rgyan so so'i rnam par gyur

zhes brjod cing snying po tshar gsum res byin gyis brlabs/ de nas slob ma rnams bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor zhes sogs mngon rtogs ltar mgon po 'khor bcas yongs rdzogs su bskyed la spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa so so dang gnyis su med par gyur/ zhes sogs brjod/ de ltar khyed rang rnams myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po dngos su gsal ba la/ phyag rnams su rdo rje'i mtshon cha rnams dang*/ dbu la sogs pa'i sku'i gnas rnams su dur khrod rol pa'i chas chen rnams phul te mda' gsol ba'i mos pa mdzod cig /ces mtshams sbyar te/ slob ma'i lag (724) g.yas su gri gug gtad nas/ skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la// phyag mtshan gri gug dbang bskur bas// dgra bgegs lus ni kha 'byed cing*// bsad pa'i las rnams thogs med shog /thod ba'i phreng ba gtad la/ skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la// mgo phreng khrag 'dzag 'di byin pas// dgra bgegs don snying 'byin pa yi// las kyis srung ma tshims byed shog /cang te'u gtad la/ skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la// thod pa'i cang te'u 'di byin pas// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dbang sdud cing*// dgra bgegs myos pa'i las 'grub shog /thod pa gtad la/ skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la// phyag mtshan thod pa'i dbang bskur bas// dgra bgegs snying khrag rol byed cing*// rengs pa'i las la thogs med shog /rtse gsum gtad la/ skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la// kha ṭāṃ rtse gsum 'di byin pas// dgra bgegs gnas gsum snun byed cing*// sgrol dang skrad pa'i las rdzogs shog /rdo rje'i zhags pa gtad la/ skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la// rdo rje'i zhags pa 'di byin pas// dgra bgegs ma lus 'dren byed cing*// 'ching ba'i las rnams rdzogs par shog /thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan bkon la/ myur mdzad ye shes mgon po yi// rgyan dang cha lugs rab 'bar ba// ye shes lnga ldan thod skam lnga// skal ldan bu yis blang bar bgyi/

mgo phreng gtad la/ myur mdzad ye shes mgon po yi// rgyan dang cha lugs rab 'bar ba// bdud rigs bsgral ba'i mgo phreng 'di// skal ldan bu yis blang bar bgyi/ sbrul rgyan bkon la/ myur mdzad ye shes mgon po yi// rgyan dang cha lugs rab 'bar ba// dug lnga dag pa'i sbrul rgyan rnams// skal ldan bu yis blang bar bgyi/ glang lpags gtad la/ myur mdzad ye shes mgon po yi// rgyan dang cha lugs rab 'bar ba// (735)gti mug rnam dag glang chen lpags// skal ldan bu yis blang bar bgyi/ stag sham gtad la/ myur mdzad ye shes mgon po yi// rgyan dang cha lugs rab 'bar ba// nga rgyal rnam dag stag lpags gos// skal ldan bu yis blang bar bgyi/ rgyan drug gtad la/ myur mdzad ye shes mgon po yi// rgyan dang cha lugs rab 'bar ba// pha rol phyin drug dag pa'i rgyan// skal ldan bu yis blang bar bgyi/ de nas dpral bar sindhū ra'i thig le byas la/ myur mdzad ye shes mgon po yi// rgyan dang cha lugs rab 'bar ba// gsang ba'i rdzas mchog sin dhū ras// skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dbang sdud shog /de lta bu'i sin dhū ra'i thig le'i steng du yi ge hrīḥdamar po ring cha tshegs drag dang bcas pa bcu gsum re gsal 'debs par mdzod/ byas la/ 'gro drug 'dren pa'i dpal mgon che// spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i bdag /hrīḥyig thugs rje chen po 'dis// skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro/ /zhes brjod/ de ltar brtul zhugs kyi rjes gnang byin pas/ khyed rang srid pa gsum na mthu stobs gzi brjid 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi rje bor mnga' chen gsol ba la/ de dag gis mchod pa'i bye brag sna tshogs pas mchod cing*/ rdo rje'i glus bstod pa phul bar mos shig /mchod pa gsar du bshams pa byin brlabs nas/ tshigs bcad dam sngags tsam gyis mchod/

gtso bstod rgyas bsdus gang rung gis bstod/ slar yang nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha lhan cig pas shis pa brjod pas kyang ye shes 'phel zhing brtan pa'i mnga' chen gsol bar mos shig /ces byas la bkra shis (736) bka' rgya ma brjod cing me tog 'thor/ de ltar na de dag rnams kyis myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po'i byin rlabs kyi bka' rtsa ba dang yan lag deng sang rgyun bzhugs nges pa rnams legs par phul grub pa yin pas/ spyir rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig mtha' dag /sgos su mgon po 'di nyid kyi khyad par gnad kyi dam tshig ji skad bshad pa mtha' dag ma nyams par bsrung ba dang*/ bsnyen sgrub phrin las kyi rim pa la brtson cing*/ bla ma yi dam dang gnyis su med pa rnam dag chos sku'i rang bzhin tu shes pas srog ltar du brten snyam du mos la 'di'i rjes zlos/ gtso bos ji ltar lan gsum/ slob mas gtong rag gser gyi maṇḍal dang*/ lus longs spyod 'bul/ dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo/ rjes tshogs kyi 'khor los mnyes par byas shing dpon slob rnams kyis longs spyod/ slob dpon gyis gtong rag mchod bstod bzod gsol sogs rgyas par bya'o// bstan la sems pa'i blo mthu thob// 'dun gros nges par legs la phyogs// rang 'dod tsam min gzhan gyi don// mtha' yas bsgrub phyir 'di byas so// mtha' rten brtul zhugs rjes gnang gi le tshan no// de ltar ye shes mgon po 'di nyid lhag pa'i chos skyong du 'dzin pa la med du mi rung ba'i rjes gnang gi bka' spol kho bos thob pa ni re zhig de tsam ste/ de la rtsa ba mgon mthing gi bka' bar chad kun sel 'di la'ang jo nang rje btsun chen po nas brgyud pa tha dad pa gsum/ dkar mthing gnyis la phyag len mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yod pa bka' brgyud kaṃ tshang dang*/

sa skya pa'i lugs srol gnyis rnams nos shing*/ gzhan rnams ni brgyud pa'i srol gnyis las byon pa ste/ mkhas grub khyung po nas da lta'i bar du bka' yod nges shing bslad ma zhugs pa'i rnam par dag pa'o// 'di nang phyi ma'i don kun bde blag tu// gsol ba btab na nges par stsol mdzad pa// bla ma nag po chen po'i byin rlabs bka'// gsal bar bkod la slar yang rjes brtser mdzod// byang chub lam gyi bar chad zhi ba dang*// chos mthun dpal 'byor dbyar gyi mtsho bzhin rgyas// gang 'brel tshe 'od dpag med zhing khams su// ye shes mgon pos lam

(737) sna 'dren gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni rang nyid nas 'dun rtsol chen po byas pa'i snod dag par/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med pa'i byin rlabs kyi bcud cung zad thob pa/ skal mnyam gzhan dag la'ang bgo bsha' sbyin par bya sla ba'i ched du/ bla ma ye shes mgon pos rjes su bzung ba'i ku sā li karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes/ myur mdzad mgon po'i byin rlabs kyi snang bas srung ba'i gnas mchog tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi sgrub sde/ kun bzang bde chen 'od gsal gling du bris pa dge legs 'phel/// / (738)
